steps.text: Mash the potatoes with warm milk, remaining butter and nutmeg and fold in the apples. Serve with the black pudding and onions.

title: Labskaus
summary: Sailors' food from the north: pink potato and corned beef mash with beetroot, fried egg and pickled herring.

steps.text: Peel, dice and boil the potatoes until tender.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Dice the onion and sweat in butter. Break up the corned beef and fry briefly with it.
Drain the potatoes and coarsely mash with the corned beef and a splash of beetroot juice. Fold in a little finely diced beetroot.
steps.tip: The beetroot juice gives it the signature pink color. Be generous!

steps.text: Fry the eggs.
steps.label: Fried eggs

steps.text: Serve the labskaus with fried egg, beetroot, pickle and rollmop.

title: Red Berry Pudding with Vanilla Sauce
summary: North German berry pudding, fruity and slightly tart, with cool vanilla sauce.

steps.text: Bring the juice to a boil with the sugar. Mix the starch with a little cold water, stir in and bring back to a boil.
Add the berries and bring to a boil just once so they stay whole. Let it cool.
steps.tip: Don't boil long. Whole berries are what separates it from jam.

steps.text: For the sauce, heat the milk with the vanilla seeds. Whisk the yolks with 1 tbsp sugar, slowly stir in the hot milk.
Return to the pot and stir over low heat until slightly thick. Don't let it boil!
steps.label: Vanilla sauce

steps.text: Serve the pudding cold with the vanilla sauce.

title: Potato Soup with Sausages
summary: Creamy potato soup with soup vegetables, marjoram and frankfurters. Just like Grandma's.

steps.text: Peel or trim the potatoes, soup vegetables and onion and dice them.
Render the bacon in the pot and sweat the onion and vegetables in it.
steps.label: Sweat

steps.text: Add the potatoes and stock and simmer until everything is soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Purée half the soup and leave the rest chunky. Season with marjoram, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Rub the marjoram between your palms before adding it. That wakes up the flavor.

steps.text: Slice the sausages and warm them in the soup.
steps.label: Warm sausages

title: Lentil Stew with Smoked Sausage
summary: Hearty stew of brown lentils, potatoes and smoked sausage, with a splash of vinegar.

steps.text: Dice the onion and soup vegetables, sweat in oil. Briefly fry the tomato paste with them.
Add the lentils, stock and bay leaves and simmer.
steps.tip: Only salt at the end. Salt from the start keeps lentils hard.
steps.label: Simmer lentils

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and add them with the sausages. Keep simmering until everything is soft.
steps.label: Simmer stew

steps.text: Season sweet and sour with vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper. Slice the sausages.

title: Hunter's Schnitzel with Mushroom Cream
summary: Juicy unbreaded pork schnitzel with creamy mushroom sauce and spätzle.

steps.text: Pound the cutlets flat and season. Slice the mushrooms, chop the shallot.
Fry the cutlets in clarified butter for 2 to 3 minutes per side, remove and keep warm.
steps.label: Fry cutlets

steps.text: Sear the mushrooms in the pan fat, add the shallot, deglaze with stock and scrape up the browned bits.
steps.tip: The brown bits in the pan are pure flavor for the sauce.
steps.label: Fry mushrooms

steps.text: Pour in the cream, reduce and season. Toss the spätzle in butter.
steps.label: Reduce sauce

steps.text: Pour the sauce over the schnitzel, sprinkle with parsley and serve with spätzle.

title: Creamed Kohlrabi with Boiled Potatoes
summary: Tender spring kohlrabi in a light cream sauce with nutmeg and parsley.

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Peel the kohlrabi and cut into sticks. Finely chop the tender leaves and set aside.
steps.tip: The young leaves taste like spinach. Add them to the sauce at the end!

steps.text: Cook the kohlrabi in a little salted water until tender-crisp, drain and save 200 ml of the water.
steps.label: Cook kohlrabi

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the cooking water, milk and cream and simmer until smooth.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Add the kohlrabi, leaves and parsley, season with nutmeg and serve with the potatoes.

title: Steamed Yeast Dumplings with Vanilla Sauce
summary: Fluffy yeast buns with a caramelized salty crust on the bottom and vanilla sauce. A Palatinate childhood favorite.

steps.text: Knead flour, yeast, 40 g sugar, a pinch of salt, egg, 50 g soft butter and 250 ml lukewarm milk into a smooth dough.
Let it rise covered in a warm place.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Shape 8 balls and let them rise briefly again.
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: In a large pot with a tight lid, heat 150 ml milk, the remaining butter and 1 tsp salt. Place the balls in, put the lid on.
Cook over medium heat until it crackles and the liquid has evaporated.
steps.tip: Do not lift the lid! They'll collapse. When it crackles, the crust is forming.
steps.label: Steam buns

steps.text: Meanwhile, cook the vanilla sauce with 250 ml milk as directed. Serve the buns crust side up.

title: Apple Pancakes with Cinnamon Sugar
summary: Thick pancakes with baked-in apple slices, caramelized and dusted with cinnamon sugar.

steps.text: Whisk flour, milk, eggs, 1 tbsp sugar and salt into a smooth batter and let it rest briefly.
steps.label: Rest batter

steps.text: Peel, core and thinly slice the apples. Mix the remaining sugar with the cinnamon.
Melt a little butter in the pan, briefly fry a quarter of the apples, pour a ladle of batter over them.
Cook over medium heat until the top is set, flip and finish. Repeat with the rest.
steps.tip: To flip, slide it onto a plate and turn it back into the pan upside down.
steps.label: Cook pancake

steps.text: Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and serve warm.

title: French Toast with Berries
summary: Stale bread soaked in egg and milk and fried golden. With berries and powdered sugar.

steps.text: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla sugar and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Soak the bread slices in it on both sides.
steps.tip: Dry day-old bread soaks up more and doesn't fall apart.

steps.text: Fry in butter over medium heat until golden on both sides.
steps.label: Fry

steps.text: Serve with berries and powdered sugar.

title: Red Cabbage with Dumplings and Mushrooms
summary: Home-braised red cabbage with apple, potato dumplings and a creamy mushroom sauce. A meatless feast.

steps.text: Finely shred the red cabbage, dice the apple and half the onion.
Sweat the onion in butter, add the cabbage and apple, deglaze with wine, vinegar and 100 ml water. Add bay, cloves, salt and braise covered.
steps.tip: Red cabbage tastes even better the next day. Make a double batch!
steps.label: Braise cabbage

steps.text: Simmer the dumplings in salted water as directed.
steps.label: Simmer dumplings

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and remaining onion, pour in the cream and reduce.
steps.label: Mushroom sauce

steps.text: Season the cabbage with redcurrant jelly and serve with dumplings and mushroom sauce.

title: Crispy Duck Breast with Red Cabbage
summary: Pink duck breast with crispy skin, orange sauce, red cabbage and dumplings. Christmas made easy.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 120 °C (250 °F). Score the duck skin in a diamond pattern without cutting the meat. Salt.
Place skin side down in a cold pan and fry slowly over medium heat until the fat has rendered and the skin is crispy.
steps.tip: A cold pan is the trick. The fat melts slowly and the skin turns glassy and crisp.
steps.label: Crisp skin

steps.text: Sear the meat side briefly, then let it finish pink in the oven.
steps.label: Duck in oven

steps.text: Cook the dumplings, warm the red cabbage.
steps.label: Simmer dumplings

steps.text: Pour off all but 1 tbsp fat, deglaze with orange juice, stock and honey, reduce and thicken with the starch mixed in water.
Rest the duck for 5 minutes, slice and serve with sauce, red cabbage and dumplings.

title: Venison Stew with Lingonberries
summary: Tenderly braised venison in a dark red wine sauce with juniper, mushrooms and lingonberries.

steps.text: Pat the meat dry and brown well in batches in clarified butter. Remove.
steps.tip: In batches! Too much meat at once stews in its own juice.
steps.label: Brown meat

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and fry, briefly toast the tomato paste. Deglaze with red wine.
Add the meat, stock, crushed juniper berries and bay leaves. Braise covered.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Quarter the mushrooms, fry and add for the last 15 minutes.
Season with lingonberries, salt and pepper. Serve with spätzle or dumplings.

title: Raclette Night
summary: Boiled potatoes, vegetables and tangy cheese melted in little pans. The coziest New Year's Eve.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins and keep warm.
steps.tip: Use small potatoes. Skin on, they fit perfectly in the little pans.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Cut the vegetables into bite-size pieces and arrange in bowls. Slice the cheese.
Preheat the raclette grill, put the cornichons and pearl onions on the table.
Everyone fills a pan with potato and vegetables, tops it with cheese and lets it melt. Season with paprika and pepper.
steps.tip: You can grill vegetables on the hot plate on top at the same time.

title: Red Herring Salad
summary: North German herring salad with beetroot, apple and pickles. Traditionally eaten on New Year's.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins, let cool and peel.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Dice the herring, beetroot, apple, pickles and potatoes small. Finely chop the onion.
Mix sour cream with mayonnaise, a splash of pickle brine and chopped dill.
Combine everything, season and let it sit for at least an hour.
steps.tip: Overnight it gets even better and turns a lovely pink.

title: Bratwurst with Onion Gravy and Mash
summary: Fried bratwurst in a dark onion gravy on creamy mashed potatoes.

steps.text: Peel, dice and boil the potatoes until soft.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Fry the bratwurst in oil until browned all over, remove.
steps.label: Fry sausages

steps.text: Slice the onions and caramelize slowly in the pan fat.
steps.tip: Be patient with the onions: the browner, the deeper the gravy.
steps.label: Caramelize onions

steps.text: Dust with flour, deglaze with stock, stir in the mustard and simmer. Return the sausages to the gravy.
steps.label: Simmer gravy

steps.text: Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and nutmeg. Serve everything together.

title: Green Bean Stew
summary: A summery stew with green beans, potatoes, savory and smoked pork.

steps.text: Trim the beans and break into pieces. Dice the potatoes and onion, cube the pork.
Fry the onion and pork in oil.
steps.label: Fry

steps.text: Add the stock, potatoes and savory and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer potatoes

steps.text: Add the beans and simmer until everything is tender.
steps.tip: Savory is the classic bean herb: it makes beans easier to digest and more flavorful.
steps.label: Simmer beans

steps.text: Season and serve hot.

title: Asparagus Salad with Strawberries
summary: White and green asparagus, marinated while warm, with strawberries, arugula and toasted almonds.

steps.text: Peel the white asparagus, the green only at the bottom. Cut off the woody ends and cut into pieces.
Cook the white asparagus in salted water with a pinch of sugar, adding the green for the last 3 minutes.
steps.label: Cook asparagus

steps.text: Whisk balsamic, honey, oil, salt and pepper and marinate the warm asparagus in it.
steps.tip: Marinate while warm! That's when it really soaks up the dressing.

steps.text: Toast the almonds without fat. Quarter the strawberries.
Toss the asparagus with strawberries and arugula and sprinkle with almonds.

title: Quark Pancakes with Apple Sauce
summary: Saxon potato and quark cakes, fried golden, with cinnamon sugar and apple sauce.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and press through a ricer while warm. Let cool.
steps.tip: Day-old potatoes are best. They're drier and the dough is less sticky.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Knead with the quark, egg, flour, 1 tbsp sugar, salt and raisins.
Shape small flat cakes with floured hands.
Fry in butter on both sides until golden.
steps.label: Fry cakes

steps.text: Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and serve with apple sauce.

title: Pancake Strip Soup
summary: Swabian broth with thin strips of pancake and chives.

steps.text: Whisk flour, milk, eggs, salt and nutmeg into a thin batter and rest briefly.
steps.label: Rest batter

steps.text: Cook very thin pancakes one after another in a little butter.
steps.tip: Swirl the pan so the batter spreads thin. The thinner, the finer the strips.

steps.text: Roll up the pancakes and cut into thin strips.
Bring the stock to a boil and season well.
Divide the strips among bowls, pour over the hot broth and sprinkle with chives.

title: Onion Roast Beef
summary: Quickly seared rump steak with crispy fried onions and gravy. A Swabian-Austrian classic.

steps.text: Slice the onions into thin rings and dust with flour and paprika.
Fry the onions in batches in hot oil until golden, drain on paper towels and salt.
steps.tip: Take them out as soon as they're light brown. They keep darkening.
steps.label: Fry onions

steps.text: Snip the fat edge of the steaks, brush with mustard, pepper. Fry in butter for 2 to 3 minutes per side. Rest.
steps.label: Fry steaks

steps.text: Deglaze the pan with stock and reduce a little. Warm the spätzle.
steps.label: Reduce gravy

steps.text: Salt the steaks and serve with gravy and a pile of crispy onions.

title: Farmer's Breakfast
summary: Fried potatoes with bacon and onions, set with eggs. With a pickle on the side. Not breakfast, a dinner.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins, cool, peel and slice.
steps.tip: Best with yesterday's boiled potatoes. They get the crispiest.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Fry the potatoes in clarified butter until crispy all over. Only turn them once they're crisp.
steps.label: Fry potatoes

steps.text: Add the bacon and diced onion and fry with them.
steps.label: Fry bacon

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and chives, pour over and let set over low heat.
steps.label: Set eggs

steps.text: Serve with pickles.

title: Leipzig Mixed Vegetables with Potatoes
summary: Young spring vegetables in butter: carrots, peas, asparagus and kohlrabi with a light sauce.

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Peel and halve the carrots, cut the kohlrabi into sticks and the asparagus into pieces.
Cook the vegetables one after another in the stock until tender-crisp: carrots and kohlrabi first, asparagus and peas last.
steps.tip: Each vegetable has its own cooking time. That keeps everything crisp and colorful.
steps.label: Cook vegetables

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, cook with the vegetable stock and cream into a light sauce.
steps.label: Sauce

steps.text: Add the vegetables to the sauce, sprinkle with parsley and serve with the potatoes.

title: Jacket Potatoes with Herb Quark
summary: Simple and perfect: new potatoes with creamy herb quark and linseed oil.

steps.text: Scrub the potatoes and boil them in salted water in their skins.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Finely chop the herbs, finely grate the garlic, slice the radishes.
Stir the quark smooth with the milk, mix in the herbs, garlic, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: A splash of sparkling water instead of milk makes the quark extra fluffy.

steps.text: Make a well in the quark, fill with linseed oil and serve with radishes and potatoes.

title: Rhubarb Crumble
summary: Tart rhubarb under crunchy butter crumble, warm with vanilla ice cream or cream.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Trim the rhubarb and cut into pieces, halve the strawberries.
Mix the fruit with 40 g sugar and the vanilla sugar in a baking dish.
Rub flour, oats, remaining sugar and cold butter into crumbs with your fingers and scatter over the fruit.
steps.tip: The butter has to be cold. Then the crumble gets crunchy instead of doughy.

steps.text: Bake until golden and the juices bubble at the edges.
steps.label: Bake crumble

steps.text: Cool briefly and serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Plum Dumplings
summary: Austrian potato dough dumplings with a whole plum inside, rolled in buttery crumbs and cinnamon sugar.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and press through a ricer while hot. Let cool.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Quickly knead with the flour, egg, salt and 20 g butter into a smooth dough.
steps.tip: Don't knead too long, or the dough gets sticky.

steps.text: Pit the plums and put a sugar cube in place of the stone. Wrap each in dough and roll into a ball.
Simmer the dumplings in salted water until they float, then 3 more minutes.
steps.label: Simmer dumplings

steps.text: Toast the crumbs in the remaining butter until golden, mix with sugar and cinnamon. Roll the dumplings in it.

title: Plaice Finkenwerder Style
summary: Whole plaice fried in butter, with crispy bacon and shrimp. A Hamburg harbor classic.

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Render the bacon in a pan until crispy, remove.
Rinse the plaice, pat dry, salt, dredge in flour and fry in butter and bacon fat on each side.
steps.tip: Fry the dark skin side first. Only flip when it's golden.
steps.label: Fry plaice

steps.text: Briefly warm the bacon and shrimp in the remaining butter.
Serve the plaice with the bacon and shrimp butter, parsley, lemon and potatoes.

title: Shoyu Ramen
summary: Savory soy broth with ramen noodles, marinated egg, chicken and spring onions.

steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook exactly 6 minutes 30 seconds, then shock in ice water and peel.
steps.tip: For ramen eggs: soak overnight in 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp mirin. They'll turn amber.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Bring the stock to a boil with sliced ginger and crushed garlic. Poach the chicken gently in it.
steps.label: Poach chicken

steps.text: Take out the chicken and slice. Season the broth with soy and mirin.
Cook the noodles in separate water and drain.
steps.tip: Never cook them in the broth. The starch makes it cloudy.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Put the noodles in bowls, pour over the hot broth, top with chicken, halved egg, spring onions, nori and a few drops of sesame oil.

title: Miso Ramen with Tofu
summary: Creamy miso broth with crispy tofu, corn, bok choy and ramen noodles.

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cube it, toss in starch and fry in oil until crispy.
steps.tip: Press the tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes first. It gets much crispier.
steps.label: Fry tofu

steps.text: Grate ginger and garlic, fry briefly in sesame oil, pour in the stock and bring to a boil.
Halve the bok choy and cook in the broth for 2 minutes. Cook the noodles separately.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Take the pot off the heat. Stir the miso smooth with a little broth and add it with the soy sauce.
steps.tip: Never boil miso, or the aroma and the good cultures are lost.

steps.text: Noodles in bowls, broth over, serve with tofu, bok choy, corn and spring onions.

title: Tom Kha Gai
summary: Thai coconut soup with chicken, lemongrass, galangal and lime. Sour, spicy, creamy.

steps.text: Bruise the lemongrass with the back of a knife and cut into pieces. Slice the galangal.
steps.tip: The lemongrass, galangal and leaves aren't eaten. They're only there for aroma.

steps.text: Bring coconut milk and stock to a boil with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves and let it infuse.
steps.label: Infuse

steps.text: Cut the chicken into thin strips and the mushrooms into slices and cook them in the soup.
steps.label: Cook chicken

steps.text: Take off the heat and season with fish sauce, sugar, lime juice and chili.
Serve sprinkled with cilantro.

title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
summary: Fresh, spicy green curry with chicken, Thai basil, bamboo and coconut milk.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Scoop the thick cream off the top of the can and fry with the curry paste in oil until fragrant and the fat separates.
steps.tip: Frying in the coconut fat is the secret of a fragrant curry.
steps.label: Fry paste

steps.text: Add the chicken in strips and fry briefly. Pour in the remaining coconut milk.
Add the zucchini and bamboo and simmer until the chicken is cooked.
steps.label: Simmer curry

steps.text: Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime, fold in the basil and serve with rice.

title: Massaman Curry
summary: Mild, fragrant curry with beef, potatoes, peanuts and cinnamon.

steps.text: Fry the curry paste with the coconut cream in oil. Add the meat and brown all over.
steps.label: Brown

steps.text: Add the remaining coconut milk, 200 ml water and the cinnamon. Braise covered.
steps.tip: Slow-braised, the meat gets butter-tender.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Cut the potatoes and onion into chunks, add with the peanuts and keep simmering.
steps.label: Cook potatoes

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Balance with tamarind, fish sauce and sugar until sweet, sour and salty. Serve with rice.

title: Pho Ga
summary: Vietnamese chicken noodle soup with toasted spices, rice noodles and a pile of fresh herbs.

steps.text: Halve the onion and ginger and char them in a dry pan. Briefly toast the star anise and cinnamon too.
steps.tip: Charring gives pho its smoky-sweet aroma.
steps.label: Char

steps.text: Bring everything to a boil with the chicken and stock, skim and simmer gently.
steps.label: Simmer broth

steps.text: Take out the chicken and shred. Strain the broth and season with fish sauce and sugar.
Pour boiling water over the noodles and let them soak.
steps.label: Soak noodles

steps.text: Noodles and chicken in bowls, hot broth over. Sprouts, herbs and lime at the table.

title: Tofu Banh Mi
summary: Crispy baguette with caramelized tofu, pickled vegetables, cilantro and sriracha mayo.

steps.text: Cut the carrot and daikon into thin sticks, mix with vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt and let it pickle.
steps.tip: The quick pickle brings the signature freshness and tang.
steps.label: Pickle vegetables

steps.text: Slice the tofu, pat dry and fry in oil until golden.
steps.label: Fry tofu

steps.text: Add the soy and remaining sugar and glaze the tofu in it.
Mix mayonnaise with sriracha. Crisp the baguette briefly in the oven and split it.
Spread with mayo, fill with tofu, vegetables, cucumber slices and cilantro.

title: Summer Rolls with Peanut Dip
summary: Rice paper filled with glass noodles, crunchy vegetables and herbs. Fresh, light, almost no cooking.

steps.text: Pour hot water over the glass noodles, let them soak and drain.
steps.label: Glass noodles

steps.text: Cut the carrot and cucumber into thin sticks, tear the lettuce and herbs.
Dip a rice paper sheet briefly in lukewarm water and lay on a damp board.
steps.tip: Only dip for 2 seconds. It softens by itself while you fill it.

steps.text: Place filling on the lower third, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat with the rest.
Stir peanut butter with soy, hoisin, lime juice and a little warm water into a dip.

title: Nasi Goreng
summary: Indonesian fried rice with sweet soy sauce, chicken, fried egg and prawn crackers.

steps.text: Finely chop shallots, garlic and chili, cut the chicken small.
Get the oil very hot in a wok, fry the chicken, then add shallots, garlic and chili.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Add the rice and stir-fry until slightly crispy.
steps.tip: Only cold day-old rice stays fluffy. Fresh rice turns to mush.
steps.label: Fry rice

steps.text: Stir in the kecap manis and salt. Fry the eggs.
Serve the rice with fried egg, cucumber slices and prawn crackers.

title: Mie Goreng
summary: Fried egg noodles with vegetables, egg and sweet-spicy soy sauce. Indonesian street food.

steps.text: Cook the noodles as directed, rinse cold and drain.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Shred the cabbage, cut the carrot into sticks and the spring onions into rings, chop the garlic.
Stir-fry garlic, carrot and cabbage in the hot wok.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Push the vegetables aside, crack the eggs into the space and scramble until set.
Add noodles, kecap manis, soy and sambal and toss well. Serve with spring onions and peanuts.
steps.tip: A really hot wok, not too full: that's how the noodles get their toasty flavor.

title: Gado-Gado
summary: Indonesian vegetable salad with potatoes, egg, tofu and a thick, spicy peanut sauce.

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
steps.label: Boil vegetables

steps.text: Cube the tofu and fry in oil until crispy.
steps.label: Fry tofu

steps.text: Stir peanut butter with grated garlic, kecap manis, sambal, lime juice and hot water into a thick sauce.
steps.tip: Add the water a spoonful at a time until the sauce flows like thick cream.

steps.text: Arrange vegetables, sprouts, cucumber, tofu and halved eggs on plates.
Pour over the peanut sauce and serve with prawn crackers.

title: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
summary: Marinated chicken skewers from the grill or pan with creamy peanut sauce and cucumber salad.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into strips and marinate with 4 tbsp coconut milk, curry, turmeric, garlic, 1 tbsp soy and the sugar.
steps.tip: Thigh instead of breast: it stays juicy even over high heat.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Slice the cucumber and toss with rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar.
Thread the meat onto the skewers in a wave and cook on a grill pan on all sides.
steps.label: Grill skewers

steps.text: Warm the remaining coconut milk with peanut butter, soy and lime juice, stirring. Serve everything together.

title: Dan Dan Noodles
summary: Sichuan noodles with savory pork, sesame sauce, chili oil and numbing Sichuan pepper.

steps.text: Toast the Sichuan pepper without fat and grind it.
steps.tip: Toasting wakes up the tingle. Untoasted, it just tastes woody.

steps.text: Fry the pork in oil until crumbly and crisp, add garlic and 1 tbsp soy.
steps.label: Fry pork

steps.text: Stir tahini, remaining soy, vinegar, sugar, chili oil and half the pepper with 3 tbsp hot water and divide among bowls.
Cook the noodles, adding the bok choy for the last minute.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Put noodles and bok choy on the sauce, top with the pork, sprinkle with spring onions and remaining pepper. Stir at the table.

title: Gyoza
summary: Japanese dumplings with pork and cabbage, crispy-fried underneath and steamed on top.

steps.text: Chop the cabbage very finely, salt, let sit 10 minutes and squeeze out firmly.
steps.tip: Squeezing is important. Otherwise the filling gets watery and the dumplings tear.
steps.label: Salt cabbage

steps.text: Mix the pork with cabbage, grated ginger and garlic, spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and sesame oil.
Put a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper, wet the edge, fold over and pleat to seal.
Fry flat side down in oil until golden. Add 80 ml water, cover and steam.
steps.label: Steam gyoza

steps.text: Remove the lid and fry until the bottom is crispy again. Serve with a dip of soy, vinegar and chili oil.

title: Japanese Vegetable Curry
summary: Mildly sweet, thick curry with potatoes, carrots and apple. Japan's favorite comfort food.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook covered with 200 ml water.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Cut the onion into wedges and fry in oil until golden. Cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks.
steps.label: Fry onion

steps.text: Add the vegetables with 500 ml water and simmer until soft.
steps.label: Simmer vegetables

steps.text: Take the pot off the heat and dissolve the curry blocks in it. Finely grate the apple and stir in with the peas and soy.
steps.tip: Grated apple is the Japanese home trick for that gentle sweetness.

steps.text: Simmer again, stirring, until thick. Serve with rice.
steps.label: Thicken curry

title: Teriyaki Tofu with Broccoli
summary: Crispy tofu cubes in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce with broccoli and rice.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Press the tofu, cube and toss in 1.5 tbsp starch. Fry in oil until crispy all over.
steps.label: Fry tofu

steps.text: Cut the broccoli into florets and steam or boil for 3 minutes.
steps.label: Cook broccoli

steps.text: Stir soy, mirin, honey, grated ginger and garlic, remaining starch and 4 tbsp water together.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and bring to a boil, stirring, until glossy and thick. Serve with broccoli, rice, sesame and spring onions.
steps.tip: Add the sauce only at the very end so the tofu stays crispy.

title: Yakisoba
summary: Japanese fried noodles with pork belly, cabbage and tangy yakisoba sauce.

steps.text: Cook the noodles, rinse cold and drain.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Stir Worcestershire, ketchup, soy, oyster sauce and sugar into a sauce.
steps.tip: This mix comes very close to the real yakisoba flavor from Japan.

steps.text: Cut the pork belly into pieces and fry in oil until crisp.
steps.label: Fry pork

steps.text: Add the cabbage and carrot in strips and stir-fry briefly.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Add noodles and sauce and fry everything well. Serve with spring onions.

title: Karaage
summary: Japanese fried chicken, marinated in soy, ginger and garlic, extremely crispy.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into large chunks and marinate with soy, sake, grated ginger and garlic.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Shave the cabbage paper-thin.
Toss the chicken in starch and fry at 160 °C (320 °F) until pale golden. Remove and rest 4 minutes.
steps.label: First fry

steps.text: Heat the oil to 180 °C (355 °F) and fry the chicken again briefly until deep golden.
steps.tip: Double frying is the secret: juicy inside, glassy-crisp outside.
steps.label: Second fry

steps.text: Serve with cabbage, lemon wedges, mayonnaise and rice.

title: Kimchi Fried Rice
summary: Korean fried rice with kimchi, gochujang and a fried egg with a runny yolk.

steps.text: Chop the kimchi, saving the juice. Slice the spring onions.
Fry the kimchi with garlic in oil until lightly caramelized.
steps.tip: Old, very sour kimchi is perfect for this.
steps.label: Fry kimchi

steps.text: Add rice, kimchi juice, gochujang and soy and fry until the rice gets crispy bits.
steps.label: Fry rice

steps.text: Fry the eggs. Drizzle the rice with sesame oil.
steps.label: Fried eggs

steps.text: Serve with the egg, spring onions, crumbled nori and sesame.

title: Japchae
summary: Korean sweet potato glass noodles with colorful vegetables, mushrooms and sesame.

steps.text: Cook the noodles, rinse cold and snip a bit shorter with scissors. Toss with 1 tbsp sesame oil.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Blanch the spinach briefly and squeeze out. Cut the remaining vegetables and mushrooms into thin strips.
Stir-fry the vegetables one by one in oil, each on its own, so they stay crisp.
steps.tip: Frying separately sounds fussy, but it keeps every vegetable's color and bite.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Stir soy, sugar, garlic and remaining sesame oil together.
Toss noodles, vegetables and sauce well with your hands or tongs. Sprinkle with sesame. Serve warm or lukewarm.

title: Tteokbokki
summary: Korean rice cakes in a fiery red, sweet and spicy gochujang sauce. Chewy, sticky, addictive.

steps.text: Soak the rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes if they're hard. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Bring the stock to a boil with gochujang, gochugaru, soy, sugar and garlic.
Add the rice cakes and simmer, stirring, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
steps.tip: Stir often! Otherwise the rice cakes stick to the bottom.
steps.label: Simmer tteokbokki

steps.text: Peel, halve and add the eggs. Serve with spring onions and sesame.

title: Pad See Ew
summary: Wide rice noodles, seared in the wok with Chinese broccoli, egg and dark soy sauce.

steps.text: Soak the rice noodles as directed until pliable and drain.
steps.label: Soak noodles

steps.text: Mix the sauces with the sugar. Slice the chicken thinly and cut the broccoli into pieces.
Get the wok very hot, fry the garlic and chicken, briefly fry the broccoli too.
steps.label: Stir-fry

steps.text: Push aside, crack in the eggs and let them set briefly.
Add the noodles and sauce and fry without stirring much until the noodles char slightly. Serve with white pepper.
steps.tip: The slightly charred spots are intentional. That's the wok aroma.

title: Larb Gai
summary: Spicy Thai ground chicken salad with lime, mint and toasted rice, in lettuce cups.

steps.text: Toast the raw rice in a dry pan until golden and grind coarsely in a mortar.
steps.tip: The toasted rice powder gives the nutty crunch. Don't skip it!
steps.label: Toast rice

steps.text: Cook the chicken with 3 tbsp water in a pan without fat until crumbly.
steps.label: Cook chicken

steps.text: Take off the heat and season with fish sauce, lime juice, chili and sugar.
Slice the onion thinly and fold in with the herbs and rice powder.
Serve in lettuce leaves.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
summary: Thai sticky rice with sweet coconut sauce and ripe mango.

steps.text: Soak the glutinous rice in water for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
steps.tip: Without soaking, sticky rice won't cook evenly.

steps.text: Drain and steam covered in a sieve over boiling water.
steps.label: Steam rice

steps.text: Warm the coconut milk with sugar and salt until the sugar dissolves. Pour two thirds over the hot rice and let it soak in.
steps.label: Let rice soak

steps.text: Peel and slice the mango.
Plate the rice with the mango, drizzle with the remaining coconut sauce and sprinkle with sesame.

title: Wonton Soup
summary: Clear broth with tender shrimp and pork dumplings, bok choy and spring onions.

steps.text: Roughly chop the shrimp, mix with the pork, grated ginger, half the spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and sesame oil.
Put a teaspoon of filling in the middle of each wrapper, wet the edges, fold into a triangle and press the corners together.
steps.tip: Press the air out of the dumplings, or they'll burst while cooking.

steps.text: Bring the stock to a boil with the remaining soy and white pepper.
Cook the wontons in gently simmering water until they float. Cook the bok choy in the broth.
steps.label: Cook wontons

steps.text: Put wontons and bok choy in bowls, pour over the broth and serve with spring onions.

title: Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Eggplant
summary: Silky soft eggplant in a sweet, sour and spicy garlic sauce. Contains no fish at all.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into finger-thick batons, salt and let sit 10 minutes. Pat dry.
steps.tip: Salting draws out water. They soak up less oil and turn creamy.
steps.label: Salt eggplant

steps.text: Fry in hot oil until soft and golden. Remove.
steps.label: Fry eggplant

steps.text: Fry ginger, garlic and bean paste in the remaining oil until the oil turns red.
Stir soy, vinegar, sugar, starch and 80 ml water together, pour in and bring to a boil. Toss the eggplant in it and serve with spring onions.

title: Chinese Tomato and Egg
summary: Fluffy scrambled egg in a sweet and tangy tomato sauce. In China, the first dish everyone learns to cook.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and a few drops of sesame oil. Cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Cook the eggs in hot oil until only half set and remove.
steps.tip: Take them out half-done! They finish in the sauce and stay fluffy.

steps.text: Fry the tomatoes with ketchup, sugar, salt and a splash of water until they break down.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes

steps.text: Return the eggs to the pan, toss briefly and serve over rice with spring onions.

title: Red-Braised Pork Belly
summary: Pork belly slowly braised in soy, rice wine and caramelized sugar until glossy and melting.

steps.text: Cut the pork belly into 3 cm cubes, bring briefly to a boil in water and drain.
steps.tip: Blanching removes impurities so the sauce turns clear and glossy.
steps.label: Blanch

steps.text: Caramelize the sugar with oil in the wok until light brown, toss the meat in it until glossy all over.
Add ginger, star anise, rice wine, both soy sauces and enough hot water to almost cover the meat. Braise covered.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Remove the lid and reduce the sauce over high heat until syrupy. Serve with spring onions and rice.
steps.label: Reduce sauce

title: Vegetable Chow Mein
summary: Stir-fried wheat noodles with crunchy vegetables in savory soy sauce. Better than takeout.

steps.text: Cook the noodles, rinse cold, drain and toss with a little oil.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Cut the vegetables into thin strips, chop the garlic. Mix the sauces with the sugar.
Get the wok very hot and stir-fry the vegetables and garlic, tossing constantly.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Add the noodles and let them fry for a minute without stirring, then toss.
steps.tip: Leaving them alone briefly gives the noodles crispy spots.

steps.text: Add the sauce and sprouts, toss and serve with sesame oil and spring onions.

title: Curry Laksa
summary: Malaysian coconut curry noodle soup with shrimp, tofu, sprouts and lime.

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in oil until fragrant. Pour in the coconut milk and stock and simmer.
steps.tip: A spoonful of peanut butter makes the broth even richer.
steps.label: Simmer broth

steps.text: Pour boiling water over the rice noodles and let them soak.
steps.label: Soak noodles

steps.text: Cook the tofu and shrimp in the broth until the shrimp are pink.
steps.label: Cook shrimp

steps.text: Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime.
Noodles in bowls, soup over, serve with sprouts, cilantro and lime wedges.

title: Salmon Poke Bowl
summary: Hawaiian bowl with marinated raw salmon, sushi rice, avocado, edamame and cucumber.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, cook covered with 200 ml water and season with rice vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Cut the salmon into 2 cm cubes and marinate with soy, sesame oil and spring onions. Keep cold.
steps.tip: Only eat sushi-grade fish raw, and use it the day you buy it.

steps.text: Boil the edamame briefly, dice the avocado and cucumber.
steps.label: Edamame

steps.text: Divide the rice among bowls, top with salmon and vegetables, finish with sesame and sriracha mayo.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Yogurt-marinated chicken, seared hot, in a spiced tomato cream sauce.

steps.text: Cube the chicken and marinate with yogurt, half the spices, one grated garlic clove and salt.
steps.tip: Marinating overnight makes the chicken even more tender.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Sear the chicken in batches in a very hot pan until it has charred spots. Remove.
steps.label: Sear chicken

steps.text: Start the rice. Finely chop the onion, remaining garlic and ginger and sweat in butter. Briefly toast the remaining spices.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Pour in the tomatoes and simmer, then add the cream and chicken and simmer on.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Season and serve with cilantro and rice.

title: Chicken Biryani
summary: Fragrant layered rice with spiced chicken, crispy onions, saffron and mint.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken with yogurt, garam masala, turmeric, grated garlic and ginger and salt. Soak the saffron in warm milk.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Slice the onions into thin rings and fry slowly in ghee until deep golden. Take out half.
steps.label: Fry onions

steps.text: Parboil the rice with the cardamom in plenty of salted water for 5 minutes and drain.
steps.tip: Only half cooked! The rice finishes cooking in the pot over the chicken.
steps.label: Parboil rice

steps.text: Add the chicken with its marinade to the onions and fry for 5 minutes. Layer the rice on top, add saffron milk, herbs and remaining onions.
Close the lid tightly and cook on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Cook biryani

steps.text: Before serving, gently fluff from the bottom so the layers mix.

title: Vegetable Korma
summary: Mild, creamy curry with cashews, cauliflower, peas and potatoes. Perfect for anyone who doesn't like it hot.

steps.text: Soak the cashews in hot water for 10 minutes and blend smooth with a little water.
steps.tip: The cashew cream makes korma velvety and slightly sweet.

steps.text: Start the rice. Chop onion, garlic and ginger and sweat in butter. Briefly toast the spices.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Dice the potatoes, cut the cauliflower into florets, add with 200 ml water and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer vegetables

steps.text: Stir in the cashew cream, cream and peas and simmer briefly. Serve with cilantro and rice.
steps.label: Simmer korma

title: Saag Aloo
summary: Spiced potatoes with spinach, cumin and ginger. Quick, cheap, very good.

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and parboil for 8 minutes.
steps.label: Parboil potatoes

steps.text: Toast the cumin seeds in oil until they crackle. Add onion, garlic and ginger and fry until soft.
steps.tip: When the seeds crackle and smell nutty, the oil is perfectly flavored.

steps.text: Add potatoes, turmeric and chili and fry until the potatoes take on color.
steps.label: Fry potatoes

steps.text: Fold in the spinach in batches and let it wilt. Season with garam masala and salt, serve with naan.

title: Rajma Chawal
summary: North Indian kidney bean curry in thick tomato gravy with rice. Indian Sunday food.

steps.text: Chop onion, garlic and ginger very finely and fry in ghee until golden.
steps.label: Fry onions

steps.text: Briefly toast the spices, add the tomatoes and cook down until the fat separates.
steps.tip: When the fat separates at the edges, the masala is done. That's the sign of a good curry.
steps.label: Cook masala

steps.text: Start the rice. Rinse the beans, add with 250 ml water and simmer. Mash some beans with the spoon.
steps.label: Simmer beans

steps.text: Season and serve with cilantro and rice.

title: Baingan Bharta
summary: Smoky flame-roasted eggplant, mashed and fried with tomato, onion and spices.

steps.text: Prick the eggplants all over and roast directly over a gas flame or under a hot broiler until the skin is black and they collapse.
steps.tip: The blacker the skin, the smokier the result. Don't be shy!
steps.label: Roast eggplant

steps.text: Cool briefly, peel off the skin and chop the flesh roughly.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger in oil, add the spices and diced tomatoes and cook until soft.
steps.label: Fry masala

steps.text: Mix in the eggplant and fry a few more minutes. Serve with cilantro and naan.
steps.label: Fry bharta

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
summary: Kashmiri lamb curry, slowly braised in yogurt and deep red spices.

steps.text: Cube the lamb and brown well in batches in ghee. Remove.
steps.label: Brown meat

steps.text: Toast the cardamom and cinnamon briefly in the fat, add onion, garlic and ginger and fry until soft.
Stir in paprika, garam masala and tomato paste. Stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time so it doesn't split.
steps.tip: One spoonful at a time over low heat keeps the sauce smooth.

steps.text: Add the meat and 200 ml water and braise covered until the lamb is tender.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Cook the rice. Season the curry and serve with cilantro.
steps.label: Rice

title: Kitchari
summary: Ayurvedic stew of rice and yellow lentils with ginger and turmeric. Light, warming, soothing.

steps.text: Rinse the lentils and rice together until the water runs clear.
Toast the cumin in ghee, briefly fry the grated ginger and turmeric with it.
Add rice, lentils and 1 liter water and simmer on low heat until porridge-like.
steps.tip: It should get really creamy. Add water as needed.
steps.label: Simmer kitchari

steps.text: Stir in the spinach, salt and serve with lemon juice and cilantro.

title: Chicken Shawarma
summary: Spice-marinated chicken strips from the pan, in flatbread with garlic sauce and vegetables.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken with lemon juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 grated garlic cloves, the spices and salt.
steps.tip: The pinch of cinnamon is the secret to that classic kebab shop aroma.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Mix the yogurt with the remaining garlic, salt and a little lemon zest.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan until the edges caramelize dark. Then slice into strips.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Slice the vegetables, warm the flatbread briefly.
Spread the bread with sauce, fill with chicken, vegetables and parsley and roll up.

title: Lahmacun
summary: Paper-thin Turkish flatbread with spiced minced meat, rolled up with salad and lemon.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to its highest setting (at least 250 °C / 480 °F) with a tray inside.
steps.label: Preheat oven

steps.text: Chop onion, pepper, tomato and half the parsley very finely and knead with the meat, both pastes, spices and salt into a spreadable paste.
steps.tip: The paste should be almost runny. That way it goes on paper-thin and stays juicy.

steps.text: Cut the dough into 4 pieces and roll out very thin. Spread the meat paste thinly to the edges.
Bake one after another on the hot tray until the edges are crispy.
steps.label: Bake lahmacun

steps.text: Top with lettuce, parsley and lemon juice, roll up and eat.

title: Imam Bayildi
summary: Braised eggplants stuffed with onions, tomatoes and garlic in plenty of olive oil. Best lukewarm.

steps.text: Peel the eggplants in stripes lengthwise, slit them lengthwise (not all the way), salt and let sit 15 minutes. Pat dry.
steps.label: Salt eggplant

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Fry the eggplants all over in 4 tbsp olive oil until they soften.
steps.label: Fry eggplant

steps.text: Slice the onions and garlic and stew slowly in the remaining oil until soft. Add the diced tomatoes, sugar, salt and parsley.
steps.tip: The onions shouldn't brown, only turn soft and sweet.
steps.label: Cook filling

steps.text: Place the eggplants in a dish, open the slits and fill generously. Pour in 100 ml water.
Bake until the eggplants are completely soft.
steps.label: Bake

steps.text: Serve lukewarm with lemon juice and flatbread.

title: Turkish Red Lentil Soup
summary: Velvety red lentil soup with mint butter and lemon. Found in every Turkish restaurant.

steps.text: Dice onion, carrot and potato and sweat in 10 g butter. Briefly toast the tomato paste and cumin.
Rinse the lentils, add with the stock and simmer until everything falls apart.
steps.tip: The potato makes the soup extra creamy without any cream.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Blend smooth and salt.
Foam the remaining butter with paprika and mint and drizzle over the soup. Serve with lemon wedges and flatbread.

title: Kısır
summary: Turkish bulgur salad with pepper paste, pomegranate molasses, herbs and lemon.

steps.text: Mix the bulgur with pepper and tomato paste, pour over 250 ml boiling water and let it soak covered.
steps.label: Soak bulgur

steps.text: Finely dice the vegetables, chop the herbs.
Fluff the bulgur with your hands and let it cool.
steps.tip: Kneading by hand is traditional. It spreads the seasoning evenly.

steps.text: Mix everything with olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses and salt and season to taste.

title: Tabbouleh
summary: Lebanese herb salad: lots of parsley, mint, tomatoes and just a little bulgur.

steps.text: Soak the bulgur with the juice of one lemon and 2 tbsp water.
steps.label: Soak bulgur

steps.text: Wash the parsley and mint and dry them very well. Slice finely with a sharp knife, don't mince.
steps.tip: Dry herbs and a sharp knife: otherwise they bruise and turn mushy.

steps.text: Finely dice the tomatoes and spring onions.
Mix everything, dress with remaining lemon juice, olive oil, allspice and salt and serve right away.

title: Fattoush
summary: Crunchy farmhouse salad with toasted flatbread, radishes, sumac and pomegranate dressing.

steps.text: Tear the flatbread into pieces and toast with 2 tbsp olive oil and a little sumac in the oven or a pan until crispy.
steps.label: Toast bread

steps.text: Roughly chop the lettuce, vegetables and herbs.
Whisk lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, grated garlic, remaining oil, sumac and salt.
Toss everything with the dressing, folding in the bread at the very end.
steps.tip: Bread last, so some stays crunchy and some soaks up the dressing. That's exactly how it should be.

title: Sabich
summary: Israeli pita sandwich with fried eggplant, egg, hummus, tahini and salad.

steps.text: Slice the eggplant, salt and fry in oil until golden.
steps.label: Fry eggplant

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and slice.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Finely dice tomato, cucumber and parsley and mix with lemon juice and salt.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice, salt and cold water until smooth.
steps.tip: Tahini first seizes up, then suddenly turns creamy. Just keep whisking in water.

steps.text: Warm the pitas, spread with hummus and fill with eggplant, egg, salad and pickles. Drizzle with tahini.

title: Koshari
summary: Egypt's national dish: rice, lentils and pasta with spicy tomato sauce and crispy onions.

steps.text: Boil the lentils in water until just tender.
steps.label: Boil lentils

steps.text: Slice the onions thinly and fry slowly in oil until deep brown and crispy. Remove, keep the oil.
steps.tip: The onion oil is gold: the rice and sauce are cooked in it later.
steps.label: Fry onions

steps.text: Toast the rice in 1 tbsp onion oil, cook covered with the lentils and 250 ml water. Cook the macaroni separately.
steps.label: Rice & lentils

steps.text: Fry the garlic in the remaining oil, add tomatoes, cumin, chili, vinegar and salt and reduce.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Layer rice-lentils, pasta and chickpeas in bowls, pour over the sauce and crown with crispy onions.

title: Harira
summary: Moroccan tomato, lentil and chickpea soup with cinnamon, ginger and cilantro.

steps.text: Finely dice onion and celery and sweat in olive oil. Briefly toast the spices.
Add tomatoes, lentils, stock and half the chopped herbs and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Add the chickpeas and noodles and simmer on.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Season with the remaining herbs, salt, pepper and lemon juice.
steps.tip: Harira is the soup for breaking the fast in Ramadan. Classically served with dates.

title: Lamb Tagine with Apricots
summary: Tenderly braised lamb with apricots, almonds and ras el hanout, sweet and spicy, with couscous.

steps.text: Cube the lamb, toss with ras el hanout and salt and brown in batches in olive oil.
steps.label: Brown meat

steps.text: Add onion and garlic and fry until soft. Add stock and cinnamon and braise covered.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Add the apricots and honey and keep braising until the meat is tender.
steps.tip: Sweet and savory together is classic Moroccan. The honey rounds out the spices.
steps.label: Braise apricots

steps.text: Toast the almonds in a dry pan. Pour 200 ml boiling salted water over the couscous and let it swell.
steps.label: Couscous

steps.text: Sprinkle the tagine with almonds and cilantro and serve with couscous.

title: Jollof Rice
summary: West African tomato rice, smoky, spicy and bright red. With fried plantains.

steps.text: Blend peppers, half the onion, chili, garlic, ginger and tomatoes until smooth.
Dice the remaining onion and fry in 3 tbsp oil, add the tomato paste and fry until it darkens.
steps.label: Fry tomato paste

steps.text: Add the purée and spices and reduce until thick.
steps.label: Reduce sauce

steps.text: Stir in the rinsed rice and stock, cover and cook on low heat.
steps.tip: It may catch a little on the bottom. That smoky crust is highly prized in West Africa.
steps.label: Cook rice

steps.text: Peel the plantains, slice diagonally and fry in the remaining oil until golden. Serve with the rice.
steps.label: Fry plantains

title: Doro Wat
summary: Ethiopian chicken stew with berbere spice and lots of onion, with hard-boiled eggs.

steps.text: Chop the onions very finely and cook without fat over medium heat until soft and golden.
steps.tip: Dry-cooking the onions is the Ethiopian technique. It makes the sauce thick and sweet.
steps.label: Cook onions

steps.text: Add butter, garlic, ginger, berbere and tomato paste and fry.
Rub the chicken with lemon juice and salt, add to the pot with the stock and braise covered.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel, score all over and add to the sauce for the last 10 minutes.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Serve with flatbread (traditionally injera).

title: Bobotie
summary: South African curried mince bake with apricots and almonds under a golden egg custard.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Soak the bread in 100 ml milk.
Dice onion, garlic and apple and fry in oil. Add the meat and curry and fry until crumbly.
steps.label: Fry meat

steps.text: Mix in the squeezed bread, chopped apricots, chutney and salt and press into a baking dish.
Whisk the eggs with remaining milk, pour over, top with bay leaves and almonds and bake.
steps.tip: The custard topping should be just set and golden, not dry.
steps.label: Bake bobotie

steps.text: Serve with rice and extra chutney.
steps.label: Rice

title: Moussaka
summary: Greek bake of eggplant, potato and cinnamon-spiced minced meat under a thick béchamel.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Slice the eggplants and peeled potatoes, brush with oil, salt and bake on trays until golden.
steps.tip: In the oven instead of the pan: much less oil and just as creamy.
steps.label: Roast vegetables

steps.text: Fry onion and garlic, brown the meat, deglaze with wine. Add tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano and reduce.
steps.label: Meat sauce

steps.text: Make the béchamel: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg. Take off the heat, stir in the egg and half the cheese.
steps.label: Béchamel

steps.text: Layer potatoes, eggplant and meat sauce, top with béchamel and the remaining cheese and bake.
steps.label: Bake moussaka

steps.text: Rest for at least 20 minutes, then cut.

title: Gemista
summary: Greek stuffed tomatoes and peppers with herb rice, baked in the oven with potatoes.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Cut the tops off the tomatoes and peppers and hollow them out. Finely chop the tomato flesh.
Sweat onion and garlic in 3 tbsp oil, add rice, tomato flesh, herbs, sugar, salt and pepper and simmer briefly.
steps.tip: The rice doesn't need to be cooked. It soaks up the vegetable juices in the oven.
steps.label: Simmer filling

steps.text: Fill the vegetables three-quarters full, put the lids on and set in a dish. Tuck potato wedges in between, drizzle with remaining oil, add 150 ml water.
Bake until the rice and potatoes are soft and the edges caramelized.
steps.label: Bake gemista

steps.text: Serve lukewarm with crumbled feta.

title: Pan Gyros with Tzatziki
summary: Spiced pork gyros with onions, homemade tzatziki and fries or flatbread.

steps.text: Marinate the meat with oregano, paprika, cumin, one sliced onion, 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Coarsely grate the cucumber, squeeze it out firmly and mix with yogurt, grated garlic, 1 tbsp olive oil and salt.
steps.tip: Squeeze the cucumber well, or the tzatziki goes watery.

steps.text: Fry the gyros in batches in a very hot pan until crispy.
steps.label: Fry gyros

steps.text: Serve with tzatziki, tomatoes, the remaining onion in rings and warm flatbread.

title: Stifado
summary: Greek beef stew with small shallots, red wine, cinnamon and cloves.

steps.text: Drop the shallots into boiling water for 2 minutes, then they peel easily.
steps.tip: The hot water trick saves a lot of time and tears.

steps.text: Brown the meat well in olive oil, fry the shallots and garlic until colored.
steps.label: Brown

steps.text: Toast the tomato paste, deglaze with wine and vinegar. Add tomatoes and spices and braise covered.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Cook the orzo in salted water.
steps.label: Cook orzo

steps.text: Season the stifado and serve with orzo.

title: Fasolada
summary: Greek white bean soup with tomato, celery and lots of olive oil. Greece's national dish.

steps.text: Dice onion, carrots and celery and sweat in 3 tbsp olive oil. Briefly toast the tomato paste.
steps.label: Sweat vegetables

steps.text: Add the beans and stock and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Stir in the remaining olive oil, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper, add parsley.
steps.tip: The raw olive oil at the end isn't an extra, it's essential. Be generous!

steps.text: Serve with feta and flatbread.

title: Briam
summary: Greek roasted vegetables with potatoes, zucchini, eggplant and tomatoes, slowly baked in olive oil.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Slice the potatoes, zucchini and eggplant, cut the onion into rings.
Grate the tomatoes and mix with garlic, oregano, parsley, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss the vegetables with the tomato mixture in a dish and bake covered with foil.
steps.label: Bake covered

steps.text: Remove the foil, stir and keep baking until everything is soft and slightly charred.
steps.tip: Briam tastes even better lukewarm the next day.
steps.label: Bake uncovered

steps.text: Serve with feta and bread.

title: Greek Lemon Oregano Chicken with Potatoes
summary: Greek sheet-pan chicken with potatoes that soak up the lemony pan juices.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Peel the potatoes and cut into long wedges.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, grated garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss potatoes and chicken with the marinade on a deep tray, chicken skin side up. Pour in the stock.
steps.tip: The stock is the secret: the potatoes soak it up and turn creamy and lemony inside.

steps.text: Bake until the chicken is crispy and the potatoes golden. Turn once halfway.
steps.label: Roast

steps.text: Serve drizzled with the pan juices.

title: Chicken and Shrimp Paella
summary: Saffron rice from the pan with chicken, shrimp, peppers and the coveted crust on the bottom.

steps.text: Cube the chicken, salt and fry in olive oil in a large pan until golden.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Add onion, garlic and pepper and fry until soft. Stir in the grated tomato and paprika and cook down.
steps.label: Sofrito

steps.text: Fry the rice briefly, pour in the hot stock with saffron, stir once and spread evenly.
From now on, no more stirring! Simmer over medium heat.
steps.tip: Not stirring is the golden rule. That's how the socarrat, the crispy crust, forms.
steps.label: Simmer paella

steps.text: Press the shrimp and peas into the rice and cook until the liquid is gone. Finally let it crackle on high heat for 1 minute.
steps.label: Cook shrimp

steps.text: Cover with a towel, rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Salmorejo
summary: Andalusian cold tomato soup, creamy from bread and olive oil, topped with egg and ham.

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Roughly chop the tomatoes and blend very smooth with the garlic and salt.
Tear in the bread, let soak 10 minutes, then blend again while slowly pouring in the olive oil.
steps.tip: Pouring in the oil slowly makes the soup as creamy as mayonnaise.

steps.text: Season with vinegar and salt and chill for at least an hour.
Serve with chopped egg and a drizzle of olive oil (and serrano ham if you like).

title: Patatas Bravas
summary: Crispy roasted potatoes with spicy paprika tomato sauce and garlic aioli. A tapas classic.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F) fan. Cube the potatoes and parboil in salted water for 7 minutes.
steps.label: Parboil potatoes

steps.text: Drain, let them steam dry, shake hard in the pot with 3 tbsp oil until the edges are roughed up.
steps.tip: The roughed-up edges turn into a crunchy crust in the oven.

steps.text: Roast on a tray until golden and crispy.
steps.label: Roast potatoes

steps.text: For the brava sauce, reduce the tomatoes with paprika, chili, vinegar, one garlic clove and the remaining oil.
steps.label: Reduce sauce

steps.text: Mix mayonnaise with the remaining grated garlic and lemon juice. Serve the potatoes with both sauces.

title: Albóndigas in Tomato Sauce
summary: Spanish meatballs in a rich tomato and paprika sauce. With bread for dipping.

steps.text: Knead the meat with egg, breadcrumbs, half the garlic, chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Shape walnut-size balls.
steps.tip: Shape with wet hands so nothing sticks.

steps.text: Brown the meatballs all over in olive oil and remove.
steps.label: Fry meatballs

steps.text: Fry the onion and remaining garlic in the fat until soft, stir in the paprika, deglaze with wine. Add the tomatoes.
Put the meatballs in the sauce and simmer covered.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.text: Sprinkle with parsley and serve with baguette.

title: Pisto with Fried Egg
summary: Spanish stewed peppers, zucchini and tomato, crowned with a fried egg.

steps.text: Cut the vegetables into even cubes.
Stew the onion and peppers slowly in olive oil until soft, then add zucchini and garlic.
steps.tip: Slow and patient: pisto is all about soft, sweet stewed vegetables.
steps.label: Stew vegetables

steps.text: Add the tomatoes and sugar and cook down until thick.
steps.label: Reduce

steps.text: Fry the eggs, set them on top of the pisto and serve with bread.
steps.label: Fried eggs

title: Garlic Chicken
summary: Spanish garlic chicken: crisp-fried with whole garlic cloves, white wine and parsley.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into large pieces, salt and pepper. Peel the garlic cloves and just crush them.
Fry the chicken in olive oil until golden all over.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Add the garlic, bay leaf and chili and fry until the garlic is golden.
steps.tip: Whole cloves turn sweet and creamy while cooking, not sharp.
steps.label: Fry garlic

steps.text: Deglaze with wine and simmer over medium heat until the sauce is syrupy.
steps.label: Reduce

steps.text: Sprinkle with parsley and serve with bread for dipping.

title: Coq au Vin
summary: French chicken braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms and pearl onions.

steps.text: Render the bacon in a Dutch oven and remove. Salt the chicken and brown all over in the fat.
steps.label: Brown

steps.text: Briefly fry carrot, garlic and onions, stir in tomato paste and flour, deglaze with wine.
Return the chicken, bacon and thyme to the pot and braise gently, covered.
steps.tip: Use a wine you'd also drink. It defines the flavor of the sauce.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in butter until golden and add them. Reduce the sauce a little uncovered.
steps.label: Reduce sauce

steps.text: Season and serve with baguette or mashed potatoes.

title: Croque Monsieur
summary: Parisian bistro sandwich with ham, Gruyère and béchamel, baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat the broiler. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, gradually whisk in the milk and cook into a thick béchamel. Season with nutmeg and salt.
steps.label: Béchamel

steps.text: Spread two slices of bread with mustard, top with ham and half the cheese, close.
Fry the sandwiches in butter on both sides until golden.
steps.label: Fry sandwiches

steps.text: Spread béchamel on top, add the remaining cheese and broil until bubbling.
steps.tip: With a fried egg on top it becomes a croque madame.
steps.label: Broil

title: Soupe au Pistou
summary: Provençal vegetable soup with beans and pasta, finished with a basil and garlic paste.

steps.text: Dice onion, carrot, potato and zucchini, cut the beans into pieces, chop the tomatoes.
Sweat the onion in 2 tbsp olive oil, add the vegetables and stock and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Add the white beans and pasta and simmer on.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Pound or blend basil, garlic, Parmesan and the remaining oil into pistou.
Ladle the soup into bowls and stir a big spoonful of pistou into each.
steps.tip: The pistou goes in raw. Cooked, it loses its freshness.

title: Salade Niçoise
summary: Summer salad from Nice with tuna, egg, potatoes, beans, olives and anchovy vinaigrette.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.
steps.label: Boil

steps.text: Plunge the beans into ice water so they stay green.
Whisk mustard, vinegar, oil, two chopped anchovies, salt and pepper into a vinaigrette.
Slice the potatoes while warm and marinate with a little vinaigrette.
steps.tip: Warm potatoes take up the dressing much better.

steps.text: Arrange lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, tuna, halved eggs, olives and anchovies and drizzle.

title: Hachis Parmentier
summary: French minced beef bake under a thick, golden mashed potato topping.

steps.text: Peel, dice and boil the potatoes until soft.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Finely dice onion, garlic and carrot and fry. Add the meat and brown. Stir in tomato paste, thyme and stock and reduce.
steps.label: Fry meat

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Mash the potatoes with warm milk, butter and nutmeg.
Put the meat in a dish, spread the mash on top, draw grooves with a fork and sprinkle with cheese.
steps.tip: The fork grooves turn into crispy ridges in the oven.

steps.text: Bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake

title: Mustard Chicken
summary: French chicken in a creamy sauce of Dijon mustard, white wine and tarragon.

steps.text: Season the chicken and fry skin side down in butter until golden. Turn and fry briefly. Remove.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Finely chop the shallots and sweat in the fat. Deglaze with wine and reduce by half.
steps.label: Reduce wine

steps.text: Stir in the cream and Dijon, return the chicken to the pan and simmer until cooked through.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.text: Stir in the wholegrain mustard and chopped tarragon and serve with baguette.
steps.tip: Add the mustard at the end, at least the wholegrain. Cooking makes it mild.

title: Crêpes
summary: Paper-thin French pancakes, sweet with sugar and lemon or chocolate spread.

steps.text: Whisk flour, milk, eggs, sugar, salt and 20 g melted butter until smooth. Let rest.
steps.tip: Resting makes crêpes tender and tear-proof.
steps.label: Rest batter

steps.text: Wipe a pan with a little butter and heat well.
Pour in a small ladle of batter and swirl to spread thin. Cook until the edge lifts, flip.
steps.tip: The first crêpe always fails. That's tradition!

steps.text: Fill with sugar and lemon or chocolate spread and fold.

title: Galette Complète
summary: Breton buckwheat galette with ham, cheese and a fried egg. Savory and crisp.

steps.text: Whisk buckwheat flour, 1 egg, 300 ml water and a pinch of salt until smooth. Let rest.
steps.tip: Ideally rest it overnight. The galettes get extra crispy.
steps.label: Rest batter

steps.text: Wipe a large pan with butter, spread a ladle of batter thin and cook until the underside is crispy.
steps.label: Cook galette

steps.text: Scatter cheese and ham on top, crack an egg into the middle. Cover until the white is set.
steps.label: Set egg

steps.text: Fold the edges in to make a square, leaving the yolk visible. Serve with arugula.

title: Tarte Tatin
summary: Upside-down apple tart with caramel and crisp puff pastry. French elegance from one pan.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Peel, quarter and core the apples.
Caramelize the sugar in an ovenproof pan without stirring until golden brown, stir in the butter.
steps.tip: Only swirl, don't stir. Otherwise the sugar crystallizes.

steps.text: Stand the apples tightly upright in the caramel and cook over medium heat.
steps.label: Caramelize apples

steps.text: Lay the puff pastry on top, tuck the edges in and bake.
steps.label: Bake tart

steps.text: Cool for 5 minutes, then boldly flip onto a plate. Serve with crème fraîche.

title: Fish and Chips
summary: Crispy beer-battered cod with oven fries and mushy peas.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Cut the potatoes into thick sticks, toss with 2 tbsp oil and salt and bake on a tray until crispy.
steps.label: Bake fries

steps.text: Boil the peas, mash coarsely with butter, mint and salt.
steps.label: Cook peas

steps.text: Whisk 120 g flour, baking powder, salt and ice-cold beer into a thick batter.
steps.tip: Ice-cold beer and brief mixing: the bubbles make the batter light and crispy.

steps.text: Pat the fish dry, salt, dust with remaining flour, dip in the batter and fry in 180 °C (355 °F) oil until golden.
steps.label: Fry fish

steps.text: Serve with fries, peas, lemon and a splash of vinegar.

title: Shepherd's Pie
summary: British minced lamb pie with vegetables in a rich gravy under a mashed potato topping.

steps.text: Peel, dice and boil the potatoes until soft.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and fry. Add the lamb and brown well.
steps.label: Fry meat

steps.text: Stir in flour and tomato paste, add stock, Worcestershire and thyme and simmer. Fold in the peas at the end.
steps.label: Simmer filling

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Mash the potatoes with milk and butter and spread over the filling. Sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake until golden on top and the gravy bubbles at the edges.
steps.tip: Made with beef, it's called cottage pie. Just as good.
steps.label: Bake

title: Pulled Pork Burgers
summary: Pork shoulder slow-cooked in the oven for hours, pulled with BBQ sauce, in brioche buns with coleslaw.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 140 °C (285 °F). Mix sugar, paprika, garlic powder, 1 tbsp salt and pepper and rub all over the meat.
Place the meat in a roasting pan with 100 ml water and 2 tbsp vinegar, cover and cook until butter-soft.
steps.tip: It's done when the meat pulls apart effortlessly with two forks.
steps.label: Slow-cook pork

steps.text: Finely shred cabbage and carrot, mix with mayonnaise, remaining vinegar, salt and pepper into coleslaw.
Pull the meat apart and mix with BBQ sauce and some pan juices.
Toast the buns, fill with the pork and coleslaw.

title: Jambalaya
summary: Spicy rice pot from Louisiana with chicken, shrimp, smoked sausage and peppers.

steps.text: Slice the sausage, cube the chicken and fry in oil. Remove.
steps.label: Fry

steps.text: Dice onion, pepper and celery and fry in the fat until soft. Briefly toast the garlic and Cajun seasoning.
steps.tip: Onion, pepper and celery are called the holy trinity in Louisiana.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Add rice, tomatoes, stock, sausage and chicken, bring to a boil and cook covered.
steps.label: Cook rice

steps.text: Press the shrimp into the rice and cook covered until pink.
steps.label: Cook shrimp

steps.text: Sprinkle with spring onions and serve.

title: Corn Chowder
summary: Creamy American corn soup with potatoes, peppers and a hint of smoke.

steps.text: Dice the onion, pepper and potatoes. Sweat the onion and pepper in butter.
Stir in the flour and paprika, gradually pour in the stock and milk.
Add the potatoes and corn and simmer until the potatoes are soft.
steps.label: Simmer chowder

steps.text: Blend a third of the soup and return it.
steps.tip: Partly blending makes it creamy while keeping some chunks.

steps.text: Serve sprinkled with cheddar and chives.

title: American Pancakes
summary: Thick, fluffy pancakes with maple syrup and blueberries.

steps.text: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Whisk buttermilk, egg and 30 g melted butter.
Stir the two together briefly, just until no flour is visible.
steps.tip: Lumps are welcome! Overmixing makes pancakes tough and flat.

steps.text: Heat a pan with a little butter over medium heat, add small ladles of batter, press blueberries on top.
Flip when bubbles form on top and cook briefly.
steps.label: Cook pancakes

steps.text: Serve stacked with maple syrup.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad
summary: Crunchy romaine, seared chicken, croutons and the creamy Parmesan anchovy dressing.

steps.text: Cube the bread and toast in a pan with 2 tbsp olive oil until crispy.
steps.label: Croutons

steps.text: Season the chicken and fry in the remaining oil on each side. Rest and slice.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Finely chop the anchovies and garlic, mix with mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice and half the Parmesan.
steps.tip: You won't taste the anchovies as such, they just add that deep savoriness.

steps.text: Tear the lettuce, toss with the dressing, top with chicken, croutons and remaining Parmesan.

title: Bean Enchiladas
summary: Tortillas filled with beans, corn and peppers, baked in red sauce with cheese.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Dice onion, garlic and pepper and fry in oil.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Briefly boil the passata with cumin, chili and salt. Mix half of it with the beans, corn and vegetables.
Divide the filling and half the cheese among the tortillas, roll up and pack tightly in a dish.
steps.tip: Warm the tortillas briefly so they don't crack when rolling.

steps.text: Pour over the remaining sauce and cheese and bake.
steps.label: Bake

steps.text: Serve with sour cream and cilantro.

title: Burrito Bowl
summary: Lime rice, black beans, charred corn, guacamole and salsa in one colorful bowl.

steps.text: Cook the rice and toss with lime juice, salt and chopped cilantro.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Pat the corn dry and char in a hot pan without stirring until it has dark spots.
steps.tip: The charred spots bring sweetness and smoke, like from the grill.
steps.label: Char corn

steps.text: Warm the beans with cumin, paprika, a splash of water and salt.
Mash the avocado with lime and salt. Dice tomatoes and onion into a salsa.
Arrange everything in bowls and serve with sour cream.

title: Chicken Tinga Tacos
summary: Shredded chicken in smoky chipotle tomato sauce on warm tortillas.

steps.text: Poach the chicken gently in lightly salted water, then shred with two forks.
steps.label: Poach chicken

steps.text: Slice the onion and fry in oil until soft. Add garlic, tomatoes, chipotle and oregano and blend or roughly crush.
steps.tip: Chipotle is smoked jalapeño. It brings the smoky flavor. Go easy at first!
steps.label: Cook sauce

steps.text: Add the chicken to the sauce and simmer until thick.
steps.label: Simmer tinga

steps.text: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Top with the tinga, avocado, cheese, cilantro and lime.

title: Arepas with Beans and Avocado
summary: Crispy corn cakes from Venezuela, stuffed with black beans, avocado and cheese.

steps.text: Knead the cornmeal with 1 tsp salt and 320 ml lukewarm water into a soft dough, rest 5 minutes.
steps.tip: If the edge cracks when you flatten it, just work in a little more water.

steps.text: Shape 6 balls and press into 1.5 cm thick patties.
Fry in a pan with a little oil over medium heat on each side until crusted and they sound hollow when tapped.
steps.label: Fry arepas

steps.text: Warm the beans with cumin and salt and mash lightly. Season the avocado with lime.
Split the arepas and fill with beans, avocado, cheese and cilantro.

title: Ceviche
summary: Peruvian raw fish cured in lime juice, with red onion, chili and cilantro.

ingredients.name: Very fresh white fish fillet (e.g. sea bream)

steps.text: Peel and slice the sweet potato and boil until tender. Let cool.
steps.label: Boil sweet potato

steps.text: Slice the onion paper-thin and soak in cold water.
steps.tip: The water bath takes the bite out of the onion while keeping it crisp.

steps.text: Cut the fish into 1.5 cm cubes, salt and keep cold.
Mix the fish with freshly squeezed lime juice, chili and onion and let it cure until white on the outside.
steps.label: Cure fish

steps.text: Serve right away with cilantro, sweet potato and corn.

title: Empanadas
summary: Argentine pastries with a spiced beef and onion filling, egg and olives, baked golden.

steps.text: Boil one egg for 9 minutes and chop. Dice onion and pepper and fry in oil until soft.
steps.label: Boil egg

steps.text: Add the meat and brown, season with spices and salt. Let cool, then mix in egg, chopped olives and spring onions.
steps.tip: The filling has to be completely cold, or the pastry goes soft.
steps.label: Fry filling

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Cut 12 cm circles from the pastry, add filling, fold over and crimp the edge with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake empanadas

title: Lomo Saltado
summary: Peruvian stir-fry: beef with tomatoes and onions in soy sauce, with fries and rice.

steps.text: Bake the fries as directed. Cook the rice.
steps.label: Fries & rice

steps.text: Cut the beef into strips and season with garlic, cumin, salt and pepper. Cut the onion and tomatoes into wedges.
Sear the beef in batches in a smoking hot pan. Remove.
steps.tip: Really hot and in batches. That way the meat browns instead of stewing.
steps.label: Sear beef

steps.text: Fry the onion briefly, add the tomatoes, deglaze with soy and vinegar. Return the beef to the pan.
Fold in the fries, sprinkle with cilantro and serve with rice.

title: Buddha Bowl with Tahini
summary: Quinoa, roasted sweet potato, chickpeas, avocado and red cabbage with lemon tahini dressing.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (410 °F). Cube the sweet potato, drain and pat dry the chickpeas. Roast both on a tray with oil, paprika and salt.
steps.tip: Well-dried chickpeas get really crunchy in the oven.
steps.label: Roast

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa well and cook in twice the amount of salted water.
steps.label: Cook quinoa

steps.text: Finely shred the red cabbage and massage with a little lemon juice and salt.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice, grated garlic, salt and cold water until creamy.
Arrange everything in bowls, add sliced avocado and drizzle with the dressing.

title: Quinoa Salad with Feta and Pomegranate
summary: Colorful quinoa salad with cucumber, herbs, feta, pomegranate seeds and lemon. Keeps well for lunch boxes.

steps.text: Rinse the quinoa, cook in twice the amount of salted water and let cool.
steps.tip: Rinse thoroughly! Otherwise quinoa tastes slightly bitter.
steps.label: Cook quinoa

steps.text: Dice the cucumber, chop the herbs, slice the spring onions.
