Halve the pomegranate and tap out the seeds with a spoon over a bowl.
Toss everything with lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper and crumble over the feta.

title: Stuffed Baked Sweet Potato
summary: Soft-baked sweet potatoes with beans, corn, feta, lime yogurt and cilantro.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Prick the sweet potatoes several times and bake on a tray until soft.
steps.tip: Put baking paper underneath: the sugar that seeps out caramelizes and sticks otherwise.
steps.label: Bake sweet potatoes

steps.text: Warm the beans and corn in a pan with oil, cumin, paprika and salt.
Mix the yogurt with lime juice and salt.
Split the sweet potatoes lengthwise, press open and fill with beans, yogurt, feta, spring onions and cilantro.

title: Whole Roasted Cauliflower
summary: A whole cauliflower, spiced and roasted golden in the oven, with herb yogurt and pomegranate.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Parboil the whole cauliflower in salted water for 6 minutes and drain well.
steps.tip: Parboiling makes sure it's tender inside before the outside burns.
steps.label: Parboil cauliflower

steps.text: Mix the oil with ras el hanout, grated garlic and salt and brush all over the cauliflower.
Roast in a dish until deep golden brown.
steps.label: Roast cauliflower

steps.text: Mix the yogurt with chopped herbs, lemon juice and salt.
Set the cauliflower on the yogurt, scatter with pomegranate seeds and cut like a cake.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
summary: Velvety broccoli soup with sharp cheddar. With crusty bread, a whole dinner.

steps.text: Chop onion, carrot and garlic and sweat in butter. Stir in the flour.
Gradually pour in the stock and milk. Chop the broccoli small (peeled stalk too) and add it.
Simmer until the broccoli is soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Blend coarsely, take off the heat and stir in the grated cheddar a little at a time.
steps.tip: Never add cheese to boiling soup, or it turns stringy and grainy.

steps.text: Season with nutmeg and pepper and serve with toasted bread.

title: Carrot Ginger Soup
summary: Bright orange soup with fresh ginger, coconut milk and a hint of orange.

steps.text: Peel and slice the carrots, chop the onion and ginger.
Sweat the onion and ginger in oil, briefly toast the curry, add the carrots.
Pour in the stock and two thirds of the coconut milk and simmer until the carrots are soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Blend smooth with the orange juice and season.
steps.tip: The orange juice freshens the soup and brings out the carrots' sweetness.

steps.text: Serve with the remaining coconut milk, toasted pumpkin seeds and cilantro.

title: Chestnut Soup
summary: Velvety soup of roasted chestnuts with a touch of cream. A festive starter.

steps.text: Dice the shallots and celeriac and sweat in butter.
Briefly fry the chestnuts (set a few aside for garnish) and thyme, deglaze with stock.
Simmer until the celeriac is soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Remove the thyme, add the cream and apple juice and blend very smooth.
steps.tip: The splash of apple juice beautifully lifts the nutty chestnut flavor.

steps.text: Season with nutmeg and serve with chopped, fried chestnuts.

title: Parsnip Soup with Apple
summary: Creamy parsnip soup, slightly sweet, with apple and crunchy croutons.

steps.text: Peel and dice the parsnips, dice the apple and onion.
Sweat the onion in 20 g butter, add parsnips and apple and sweat briefly.
Pour in the stock and simmer until everything is soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Cube the bread and toast in the remaining butter until crispy.
steps.label: Croutons

steps.text: Blend the soup with the cream, season with nutmeg and serve with croutons.
steps.tip: Parsnips taste sweetest after the first frost.

title: Borscht
summary: Eastern European beetroot soup with cabbage, potatoes and dill, with a dollop of sour cream.

steps.text: Peel and coarsely grate or dice the beetroot, carrot and onion.
steps.tip: Wear gloves! Beetroot dyes everything pink.

steps.text: Sweat the onion and carrot in oil, add beetroot, tomato paste and vinegar and stew briefly.
steps.label: Stew beetroot

steps.text: Add stock, bay leaf, diced potatoes and finely shredded cabbage and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Season with garlic, sugar, salt and pepper.
Serve with sour cream and plenty of dill.

title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
summary: Deep, creamy soup of brown mushrooms, thyme and a splash of sherry.

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms, setting a few nice ones aside for garnish. Chop onion and garlic.
Sear the mushrooms in batches in butter until deep brown.
steps.tip: Fry them really brown! That gives the soup its depth.
steps.label: Fry mushrooms

steps.text: Add onion, garlic and thyme, deglaze with sherry, pour in the stock and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Remove the thyme, add the cream and blend.
Serve with fried mushroom slices, parsley and bread.

title: Cream of Asparagus Soup
summary: Delicate white asparagus soup, made with the peels for full flavor.

steps.text: Peel the asparagus and trim the ends. Bring the peels and ends to a boil with 1 liter water, salt and sugar and let steep.
steps.tip: The peels make the stock. Never throw them away!
steps.label: Steep stock

steps.text: Strain the stock. Cut the asparagus into pieces and cook in the stock, then remove the tips.
steps.label: Cook asparagus

steps.text: Sweat the shallot in butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer until smooth.
Add the asparagus pieces, blend, stir in the cream. Season with lemon and nutmeg.
Serve with the asparagus tips and chervil.

title: Wild Garlic Soup
summary: Bright green spring soup of wild garlic and potatoes with a dollop of sour cream.

steps.text: Dice the potatoes and onion and sweat in butter.
Pour in the stock and simmer until the potatoes are soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Wash and roughly chop the wild garlic, setting a few leaves aside.
Take the pot off the heat, add the wild garlic and cream and blend smooth right away.
steps.tip: Don't boil the wild garlic, or the soup turns gray-green instead of bright.

steps.text: Season with nutmeg and serve with sour cream and strips of wild garlic.

title: Cold Cucumber Soup with Dill
summary: Refreshing yogurt cucumber soup with dill and garlic. No stove, perfect for hot days.

steps.text: Peel the cucumbers, finely dice a piece for garnish, roughly chop the rest.
Blend the cucumber with yogurt, garlic, dill, lemon juice, olive oil, salt and a splash of cold water until smooth.
Chill for at least 30 minutes.
steps.tip: Blend in a few ice cubes if you're in a hurry.

steps.text: Serve with diced cucumber, chopped walnuts and olive oil, with baguette.

title: Lentil Bolognese
summary: Hearty bolognese of red lentils, vegetables and tomatoes. Even meat lovers ask for seconds.

steps.text: Dice onion, carrot and celery very finely and sweat in olive oil. Briefly toast the garlic and tomato paste.
steps.label: Sweat vegetables

steps.text: Deglaze with red wine, add lentils, tomatoes, oregano and 250 ml water and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Cook the spaghetti.
steps.label: Cook spaghetti

steps.text: Season the sauce with soy sauce, salt and pepper and serve with spaghetti and Parmesan.
steps.tip: The splash of soy sauce adds the savory depth that meat usually brings.

title: Stuffed Zucchini with Couscous
summary: Zucchini halves stuffed with couscous, tomato, feta and mint, baked in the oven.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Halve the zucchini lengthwise and hollow out with a spoon. Chop the flesh.
Pour the hot stock over the couscous and let it swell.
steps.label: Couscous

steps.text: Fry onion, garlic, zucchini flesh and diced tomato in oil. Mix with the couscous, half the feta and mint.
steps.label: Fry filling

steps.text: Fill the zucchini, crumble over the remaining feta and bake.
steps.tip: Salt the zucchini inside first so they're tastier and less watery.
steps.label: Bake zucchini

steps.text: Serve with mint yogurt.

title: Stuffed Pumpkin
summary: A small pumpkin stuffed with rice, mushrooms, cheese and herbs, baked in the oven. The Halloween showstopper.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Cut a lid off the pumpkin and scoop out the seeds. Salt the inside.
steps.tip: Carve a face into the lid if you like. Then it's a true Halloween dinner.

steps.text: Cook the rice in the stock.
steps.label: Cook rice

steps.text: Fry mushrooms, onion, garlic and chopped sage in oil. Mix with the rice, chopped walnuts and half the cheese.
steps.label: Fry filling

steps.text: Fill the pumpkin, top with the remaining cheese, place the lid alongside and bake until the pumpkin is tender.
steps.label: Bake pumpkin

steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve.

title: Mushroom Wellington
summary: Festive puff pastry roll with mushroom duxelles, spinach and chestnuts. The vegetarian Christmas dinner.

steps.text: Chop the mushrooms very finely and fry with shallots, garlic and thyme in butter until all the liquid has evaporated.
steps.tip: The mixture has to be really dry, or the pastry turns soggy.
steps.label: Cook duxelles

steps.text: Roughly chop the chestnuts, mix into the mushrooms with soy sauce and let cool. Wilt the spinach and squeeze it out well.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Unroll the pastry, lay the spinach in the middle and shape the mushroom mixture on top into a log.
Fold the pastry over, place seam side down on a tray, brush with egg and score.
Bake until golden and rest 10 minutes, then cut into thick slices.
steps.label: Bake wellington

title: Nut Roast
summary: Moist roast of nuts, lentils, vegetables and herbs with mushroom gravy. Christmas without meat.

steps.text: Cook the lentils in 300 ml stock until soft and the liquid is absorbed.
steps.label: Cook lentils

steps.text: Toast the nuts and chop roughly. Finely dice onion, carrot, garlic and half the mushrooms and fry in oil.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Combine everything with eggs, breadcrumbs, grated cheese, herbs, 1 tbsp soy, salt and pepper and press into a greased loaf pan.
Bake until firm and browned on top. Rest in the pan for 10 minutes.
steps.tip: Resting is important, or it breaks when you turn it out.
steps.label: Bake nut roast

steps.text: Fry the remaining mushrooms, reduce with remaining stock, soy and cream into a gravy. Serve the roast sliced with gravy.
steps.label: Mushroom gravy

title: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
summary: Savory lentil and vegetable filling under a blanket of potato and sweet potato mash.

steps.text: Peel, dice and boil the potatoes and sweet potato until soft.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Dice onion, carrots and garlic and fry. Briefly toast the tomato paste.
Add lentils, stock, thyme and soy and simmer until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick. Fold in the peas.
steps.label: Simmer lentils

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Mash the potatoes with butter and milk and spread over the lentils. Top with cheese.
Bake until golden.
steps.tip: Sweet potato in the mash makes the crust beautifully caramelized.
steps.label: Bake

title: Chickpea and Spinach Stew
summary: Spanish-inspired stew with chickpeas, spinach, smoked paprika and crusty bread.

steps.text: Fry a slice of bread with the garlic in 2 tbsp olive oil until golden and pound into a paste with paprika and cumin.
steps.tip: This bread and garlic paste thickens the stew and gives it depth. A trick from Andalusia.

steps.text: Sweat the onion in the remaining oil. Add the tomatoes and cook down.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes

steps.text: Stir in the chickpeas, stock and bread paste and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer stew

steps.text: Fold in the spinach, let it wilt and season with vinegar and salt. Serve with bread.

title: Greek Village Salad
summary: Tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, olives and a whole block of feta with oregano. No lettuce, no fuss.

steps.text: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, the cucumber into thick half-moons, the pepper and onion into rings.
Toss the vegetables with salt and vinegar and let sit briefly.
steps.tip: The tomato juice at the bottom is the best part. Mop it up with bread!

steps.text: Lay the feta on top in one piece, add the olives, sprinkle with oregano and drizzle generously with olive oil.
Serve with flatbread.

title: Watermelon Feta Salad
summary: Juicy watermelon with salty feta, mint, red onion and lime. Pure summer.

steps.text: Slice the onion into paper-thin rings and soak in lime juice.
steps.tip: The lime juice mellows the onion and tints it pale pink.

steps.text: Cut the melon into bite-size chunks.
Toast the pumpkin seeds without fat.
steps.label: Toast seeds

steps.text: Toss the melon with arugula, the onions and their juice, olive oil and mint, crumble over the feta, add pepper and scatter with seeds.

title: Potato and Cucumber Salad
summary: Light potato salad with cucumber, dill and a yogurt mustard dressing. Perfect for barbecues.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins, cool briefly, peel and slice.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Slice the cucumber thinly, salt and let sit 10 minutes. Then squeeze out.
steps.tip: Salting and squeezing stops the salad from swimming in cucumber water later.

steps.text: Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, sugar, chopped dill, salt and pepper.
Toss potatoes, cucumber and finely chopped onion with the dressing and let it sit 30 minutes.

title: Pasta Salad with Pesto and Tomatoes
summary: Mediterranean pasta salad without mayo: pesto, sun-dried tomatoes, mozzarella, arugula and pine nuts.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Cook the fusilli al dente, rinse cold and drain.
steps.label: Cook fusilli

steps.text: Toast the pine nuts without fat until golden.
steps.label: Toast pine nuts

steps.text: Halve the cherry tomatoes, cut the sun-dried tomatoes into strips.
Toss the pasta with pesto, a little tomato oil, balsamic, tomatoes and mozzarella. Fold in the arugula and pine nuts just before serving.
steps.tip: Pasta salad absorbs seasoning. Taste again before serving.

title: Baked Feta Pasta
summary: A block of feta and cherry tomatoes from the oven, stirred into a creamy sauce. The internet hit.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Put the tomatoes and whole garlic cloves in a dish, place the feta in the middle.
Drizzle with olive oil, chili, salt and pepper and bake until the tomatoes burst.
steps.tip: For a browner top, turn on the broiler for the last 5 minutes.
steps.label: Bake

steps.text: Cook the penne, saving a cup of pasta water.
steps.label: Cook penne

steps.text: Mash the feta, tomatoes and garlic into a sauce in the dish, toss in the pasta and a little pasta water. Serve with basil.

title: Cottage Cheese Flatbread
summary: High-protein flatbread made from just cottage cheese and eggs, topped like a pizza. The 2025 social media trend.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Blend the cottage cheese and eggs with salt and oregano until smooth.
Spread thinly (about 5 mm) on a lined baking tray and bake until firm and golden.
steps.tip: Better too long than too short: only when it's properly brown will it come off the paper.
steps.label: Bake flatbread

steps.text: Spread with tomato sauce, top with tomatoes and mozzarella.
Bake again until the cheese melts. Top with arugula.
steps.label: Bake

title: Vegetable Strudel with Herb Dip
summary: Crispy strudel pastry filled with leek, carrots, spinach and feta, with a fresh herb dip.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Slice the leek and cut the carrots into thin sticks, sweat in 10 g butter until soft. Add the spinach and let it wilt.
steps.label: Sweat vegetables

steps.text: Let the vegetables cool, drain well, mix with crumbled feta, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Brush the pastry sheets with melted butter and stack. Spread the filling on one third, fold in the sides and roll up.
steps.tip: Covered with a damp towel, filo pastry won't dry out.

steps.text: Brush with butter and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake strudel

steps.text: Mix the sour cream with chives, garlic and salt and serve with the strudel.

title: Cheese and Leek Soup
summary: Hearty party soup with ground meat, leek and melted cheese. The classic for New Year's Eve and birthdays.

steps.text: Fry the meat in oil until brown and crumbly, add the onion and fry with it.
steps.label: Fry meat

steps.text: Halve the leek lengthwise, wash thoroughly, slice and add to the meat with the mushrooms.
steps.tip: Always cut leeks before washing. There's often soil between the layers.

steps.text: Pour in the stock and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Stir in the processed cheese and cream until creamy. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Melt cheese

steps.text: Serve with baguette.

title: Dutch Baby with Apples
summary: A giant oven pancake that puffs up dramatically, with caramelized apples and powdered sugar.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F) with an ovenproof pan inside.
steps.tip: The pan has to be scorching hot so the pancake puffs up spectacularly.
steps.label: Preheat oven

steps.text: Blend eggs, milk, flour, 1 tbsp sugar and salt until smooth.
Slice the apples and caramelize briefly in 20 g butter with cinnamon and remaining sugar.
Add the remaining butter to the hot pan, spread the apples, pour over the batter and bake right away.
steps.label: Bake pancake

steps.text: Don't open the oven door! Serve immediately with powdered sugar before it deflates.

title: Whole Roast Chicken
summary: A whole chicken with herb butter under the skin, roasted crisp on root vegetables.

steps.text: Ideally salt the chicken all over the day before and keep it uncovered in the fridge.
steps.tip: Uncovered in the fridge the skin dries out. That's how it turns glassy-crisp in the oven.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Mix butter with chopped thyme, one grated garlic clove and lemon zest and push it under the breast skin.
Cut potatoes, carrots and onion into chunks, toss with oil and salt on a tray. Halve the lemon and stuff it into the chicken with the garlic.
Set the chicken on the vegetables and roast until the juices at the thigh run clear.
steps.label: Roast chicken

steps.text: Rest for 10 minutes, then carve and serve with the vegetables.

title: Honey Mustard Sheet-Pan Chicken
summary: Chicken thighs with a sweet and tangy honey mustard glaze, potatoes and green beans on one tray.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (410 °F). Halve the potatoes and toss with 1 tbsp oil and salt on a tray.
Mix honey, both mustards, garlic, remaining oil, salt and pepper. Rub over the chicken and add to the potatoes.
Roast.
steps.label: Roast

steps.text: Add the beans and roast until the chicken is crispy and caramelized.
steps.tip: If the glaze gets too dark, loosely cover with foil.
steps.label: Finish roasting

title: Chicken in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
summary: Seared chicken breast in a creamy mushroom sauce with thyme. With rice or ribbon pasta.

steps.text: Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally, season. Fry in oil until golden on each side, remove.
steps.tip: Halved fillets cook evenly and stay juicy.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Cook the pasta.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Sear the mushrooms in butter, add shallot, garlic and thyme. Deglaze with stock.
steps.label: Fry mushrooms

steps.text: Pour in the cream, return the chicken and simmer until cooked through.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.text: Serve with the pasta.

title: Chicken Piccata
summary: Thin chicken cutlets in a glossy lemon caper butter sauce.

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.
steps.label: Cook spaghetti

steps.text: Halve the chicken, pound thin, season and dredge in flour. Fry in oil 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Deglaze with wine, add stock, lemon juice and capers and reduce by half.
steps.label: Reduce sauce

steps.text: Take off the heat and swirl in cold butter until the sauce thickens.
steps.tip: Cold butter and no more boiling: that makes the sauce silky without splitting.

steps.text: Turn the chicken in the sauce and serve with parsley and spaghetti.

title: Crispy Chicken Strips with Dip
summary: Chicken strips in a crunchy cornflake coating from the oven, with honey mustard dip and oven fries.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Spread the fries on a tray and bake.
steps.label: Bake fries

steps.text: Cut the chicken into strips and salt. Crush the cornflakes in a bag and mix with paprika and oil.
steps.tip: The oil in the crumbs gives a golden crust without frying.

steps.text: Dredge the strips in flour, then beaten egg, then cornflakes.
Bake on a second lined tray until crispy.
steps.label: Bake strips

steps.text: Mix mayonnaise with honey and mustard and serve as a dip.

title: Crispy Chicken Burger
summary: Crispy fried buttermilk chicken thigh in a brioche bun with slaw and spicy mayo.

steps.text: Soak the chicken in salted buttermilk, ideally for several hours.
steps.tip: Buttermilk makes the meat tender and helps the coating stick.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Mix flour, starch, paprika and salt. Drizzle in a few spoonfuls of buttermilk and rub into crumbs with your fingers.
Press the chicken firmly into the flour mixture. Fry in 2 cm of hot oil until golden on each side.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Shred the cabbage finely and mix with 2 tbsp mayonnaise and salt. Mix the remaining mayo with sriracha.
Toast the buns and layer with sriracha mayo, chicken, slaw and pickles.

title: Pork Chops with Bacon Beans
summary: Juicy pan-fried pork chops with bacon-wrapped green beans and rosemary potatoes.

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into wedges and bake with oil, rosemary and salt at 220 °C (430 °F).
steps.label: Bake potatoes

steps.text: Blanch the beans in salted water for 5 minutes, refresh, bundle and wrap each bundle in a slice of bacon.
steps.label: Blanch beans

steps.text: Pat the chops dry, salt and sear in oil on each side. Add butter, garlic and rosemary and keep basting the meat with the butter.
steps.tip: Constant basting with butter cooks evenly and adds lots of flavor.
steps.label: Fry chops

steps.text: Rest the chops. Fry the bean bundles in the same pan until the bacon is crispy.
steps.label: Fry bean bundles

steps.text: Serve everything together.

title: Oven Spare Ribs
summary: Pork ribs slow-cooked in the oven with a sticky BBQ glaze. Tender meat that falls off the bone.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 150 °C (300 °F). Lift the membrane on the bone side with a knife and pull it off.
steps.tip: Otherwise the membrane turns tough. Grip it with a paper towel.

steps.text: Mix sugar, paprika, garlic powder, mustard, salt and pepper and rub into the ribs. Wrap tightly in foil.
Cook in the oven until the meat is tender.
steps.label: Slow-cook ribs

steps.text: Open the foil, turn the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Mix BBQ sauce with honey, brush the ribs thickly and glaze. Boil the corn.
steps.label: Glaze

steps.text: Cut the ribs into pieces and serve with buttered corn.

title: Roast Beef with Remoulade
summary: Pink roast beef, thinly sliced, with homemade remoulade and fried potatoes.

steps.text: Take the meat out of the fridge an hour ahead. Preheat the oven to 120 °C (250 °F).
Salt the meat and brown well all over in clarified butter.
steps.label: Sear

steps.text: Roast in the oven until the core temperature reaches 54 °C (130 °F) for pink.
steps.tip: A meat thermometer is the best investment. Then it works every time.
steps.label: Roast beef

steps.text: Boil the potatoes, slice and fry with onion until crispy. Hard-boil the egg.
steps.label: Fried potatoes

steps.text: For the remoulade, finely chop pickles, capers, egg and parsley and mix with mayonnaise and mustard.
Rest the meat for 10 minutes, slice thinly and serve with remoulade and fried potatoes.

title: Pappardelle with Beef Ragù
summary: Beef braised for hours in red wine and tomato, shredded and tossed with wide ribbon pasta.

steps.text: Cut the meat into large pieces, salt and brown dark all over in olive oil. Remove.
steps.label: Brown

steps.text: Finely dice the vegetables and fry until soft, toast the tomato paste, deglaze with wine and reduce.
Add tomatoes, rosemary and meat and braise very gently, covered, until the meat falls apart.
steps.tip: Great to make the day before. It tastes even better the next day.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Shred the meat with two forks and leave it in the sauce. Cook the pappardelle.
steps.label: Cook pappardelle

steps.text: Toss the pasta with the ragù and a splash of pasta water and serve with Parmesan.

title: Leg of Lamb with Rosemary and Garlic
summary: Studded leg of lamb, slowly roasted pink, with roast potatoes and green beans. The Easter dinner.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160 °C (320 °F). Pierce the lamb all over with a pointed knife and stud with garlic slices and rosemary sprigs.
Rub with oil, lemon zest, salt and pepper and brown all over in a roasting pan.
steps.label: Brown

steps.text: Quarter the potatoes and arrange around the meat. Add wine and stock and roast until the core reaches 58 °C (136 °F).
steps.tip: Let the lamb come to room temperature for an hour first. It cooks more evenly.
steps.label: Roast lamb

steps.text: Rest the meat in foil. Thicken the pan juices with cold butter into a sauce. Cook the beans in salted water.
steps.label: Cook beans

steps.text: Slice the lamb and serve with potatoes, beans and sauce.

title: Tafelspitz with Horseradish
summary: Viennese boiled beef, gently simmered in broth, with apple horseradish, chive sauce and fried potatoes.

steps.text: Halve the onion and char the cut sides in a dry pan.
Lower the meat into boiling water, add onion, bay leaves and peppercorns. Simmer gently, don't boil.
steps.tip: Put it in boiling water for juicy meat. Start cold only if you want a strong broth.
steps.label: Simmer beef

steps.text: Roughly chop the soup vegetables and add for the last 40 minutes. Salt the broth.
steps.label: Cook vegetables

steps.text: Boil the potatoes, slice and fry crisp in clarified butter.
steps.label: Potatoes

steps.text: Grate the apple and mix with horseradish. Stir the sour cream with chives and salt.
Slice the meat across the grain, spoon over some broth and serve with everything.

title: Szeged Goulash
summary: Hungarian-Austrian goulash of pork and sauerkraut with paprika and sour cream.

steps.text: Dice the onions and fry in clarified butter until golden. Add the meat and brown.
steps.label: Brown

steps.text: Take the pot off the heat briefly, stir in paprika and tomato paste, then deglaze right away with stock.
steps.tip: Paprika burns very fast and turns bitter. That's why you take it off the heat.

steps.text: Add caraway and garlic and braise covered.
steps.label: Braise

steps.text: Add the sauerkraut and keep braising until the meat is tender. Boil the potatoes separately.
steps.label: Braise sauerkraut

steps.text: Finish with sour cream and serve with potatoes.

title: Turkey Strips in Cream Sauce with Rice
summary: Tender turkey strips with mushrooms and peppers in a light cream sauce. A quick family dinner.

steps.text: Cook the rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Cut the turkey into thin strips and sear in batches in hot oil. Remove.
steps.tip: Sear only briefly, the turkey finishes cooking in the sauce.
steps.label: Fry turkey

steps.text: Fry onion, mushrooms and pepper in the fat, stir in the paprika.
steps.label: Fry vegetables

steps.text: Deglaze with stock and cream, return the meat and simmer briefly.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.text: Sprinkle with parsley and serve with rice.

title: Potato and Ground Beef Bake
summary: Potato slices and seasoned ground meat in cream sauce, baked with cheese. A family favorite.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Peel the potatoes and slice thinly.
Fry the meat with onion and garlic in oil until crumbly, season with tomato paste, paprika, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Fry meat

steps.text: Mix cream and milk with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Layer potatoes and meat in a dish, pour over the cream mixture and sprinkle with cheese.
steps.tip: The potatoes must be paper-thin, or they won't cook through.

steps.text: Bake until the potatoes are soft and the cheese is golden.
steps.label: Bake

title: Honey Mustard Crusted Salmon
summary: Oven salmon with a sweet and tangy honey mustard glaze and crunchy crumbs, with roasted vegetables.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Cut the broccoli into florets, spread on a tray with the tomatoes, oil and salt and pre-roast for 10 minutes.
steps.label: Pre-roast vegetables

steps.text: Mix honey and mustard. Mix the panko with chopped dill, lemon zest and 1 tbsp oil.
Salt the salmon, brush with honey mustard, press the crumbs on top and add to the vegetables.
Bake until the salmon is just barely translucent inside.
steps.tip: Better a minute early. Salmon keeps cooking and dries out otherwise.
steps.label: Bake salmon

steps.text: Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Green Asparagus
summary: Salmon fillet, green asparagus and new potatoes on one tray, with lemon herb butter.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (410 °F). Halve the potatoes and roast on a tray with oil and salt.
steps.label: Roast potatoes

steps.text: Peel the bottom of the asparagus and snap off the woody ends.
steps.tip: The spears snap at just the right spot when you bend them.

steps.text: Mix the butter with chopped parsley, garlic, lemon zest and salt.
Add the asparagus and salmon to the tray, top the salmon with herb butter and bake.
steps.label: Salmon & asparagus

steps.text: Drizzle with lemon juice and serve.

title: Cod in Mustard Sauce
summary: Gently poached cod in a North German mustard sauce with boiled potatoes and cucumber salad.

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Slice the cucumber thinly and dress with vinegar, sugar, salt and dill.
Sweat the shallot in butter, stir in the flour, whisk in stock and cream and simmer until smooth. Stir in both mustards.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Salt the fish, place in the sauce and let it poach covered over low heat.
steps.tip: The fish is done when it flakes into layers.
steps.label: Poach fish

steps.text: Sprinkle with dill and serve with potatoes and cucumber salad.

title: Homemade Fish Fingers
summary: Crispy breaded fish fingers made from fresh pollock with mashed potatoes and peas.

steps.text: Peel, dice and boil the potatoes until soft.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Pat the fish dry, cut into finger-thick sticks and salt.
Dredge the sticks in flour, beaten egg and panko.
steps.tip: Panko makes the crust extra crunchy. Regular breadcrumbs work too.

steps.text: Fry in oil until golden all over.
steps.label: Fry fish fingers

steps.text: Boil the peas. Mash the potatoes with milk and butter. Serve everything with lemon.
steps.label: Cook peas

title: Oven-Baked Sea Bream
summary: Whole sea bream stuffed with lemon and herbs, baked on potatoes and tomatoes. A Mediterranean holiday.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Slice the potatoes thinly, toss with 3 tbsp oil and salt in a dish and pre-bake.
steps.label: Pre-bake potatoes

steps.text: Salt the fish inside and out, score the skin diagonally two or three times. Stuff with lemon slices, garlic and herbs.
steps.tip: Clear eyes and red gills: that's how you spot fresh fish.

steps.text: Lay the fish on the potatoes, add tomatoes and olives, drizzle with wine and remaining oil.
Bake until the dorsal fin pulls out easily.
steps.label: Bake fish

steps.text: Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

title: Coconut Fish Curry
summary: South Indian-inspired fish curry with coconut milk, tomatoes, curry leaves and lime.

steps.text: Cook the rice.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Heat the mustard seeds in oil until they pop. Add onion, garlic and ginger and fry until soft.
steps.tip: When the mustard seeds jump, put a lid on briefly. Otherwise they leap out of the pan.

steps.text: Add curry, turmeric and diced tomatoes and simmer until soft. Pour in the coconut milk.
steps.label: Simmer sauce

steps.text: Cut the fish into chunks, salt and poach in the sauce. Don't stir anymore.
steps.label: Poach fish

steps.text: Season with lime juice and cilantro and serve with rice.

title: Sesame Crusted Tuna Steak
summary: Crispy sesame crust outside, pink inside: tuna with cucumber salad and rice.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Slice the cucumber thinly and marinate with rice vinegar, sugar, salt and sesame oil.
Brush the tuna with 1 tbsp soy and press into the sesame all over.
Sear in a very hot pan for only 1 minute per side.
steps.tip: Cooked through, tuna turns dry as cardboard. It has to stay pink inside.
steps.label: Sear tuna

steps.text: Slice and serve with rice, cucumber salad, spring onions and remaining soy.

title: Shrimp Coconut Curry
summary: Quick red curry with shrimp, peppers, snow peas and Thai basil.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in oil until fragrant. Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a boil.
steps.label: Fry paste

steps.text: Add the pepper strips and snow peas and simmer briefly.
steps.label: Simmer vegetables

steps.text: Add the shrimp and cook until pink and curled.
steps.tip: A C shape means done, an O shape means overcooked. Take them off in time!
steps.label: Cook shrimp

steps.text: Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime, fold in the basil and serve with rice.

title: Pike-Perch on Creamy Sauerkraut
summary: Pike-perch fried crisp on the skin, on mild creamy sauerkraut with mashed potatoes.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and mash with milk and 30 g butter.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Dice onion and apple, sweat in butter, add sauerkraut, juniper and wine and braise. Stir in the cream.
steps.label: Braise sauerkraut

steps.text: Lightly score the pike-perch skin a few times, dust with flour and salt.
Fry skin side down in butter until the skin is crisp. Turn only briefly.
steps.tip: Press flat with a spatula for the first minute so the fish doesn't curl.
steps.label: Fry fish

steps.text: Serve the fish on the sauerkraut with the mash.

title: Salmon in Puff Pastry
summary: Salmon fillet with a spinach and cream cheese filling in a golden puff pastry crust. Festive and easy.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Wilt the spinach with the garlic, squeeze well and chop.
Mix the spinach with cream cheese, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Squeeze it well! Wet spinach makes the pastry soggy underneath.

steps.text: Salt the salmon, place on the pastry and spread the spinach mixture on top. Fold the pastry over and place seam side down on a tray.
Brush with egg, score a pattern and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake salmon

steps.text: Mix sour cream with dill and lemon juice. Slice the salmon and serve with dill sauce.

title: Fish Tacos with Lime Slaw
summary: Crispy pan-fried fish in tortillas with lime slaw, avocado and chipotle mayo.

steps.text: Shred the cabbage finely, massage with lime juice and salt and let sit.
Mix mayonnaise with chopped chipotle and a little lime juice.
Cut the fish into strips, dust with flour, cumin, paprika and salt and fry in oil until crispy.
steps.tip: Don't turn the fish too often, or it falls apart.
steps.label: Fry fish

steps.text: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Top with slaw, fish, avocado, mayo and cilantro.

title: Pollock with Roasted Vegetables and Pesto
summary: Pollock fillet on colorful roasted vegetables with green pesto. Healthy, quick, one tray.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (410 °F). Cut the vegetables into pieces and roast on a tray with oil and salt.
steps.label: Roast vegetables

steps.text: Salt and pepper the fish and brush with pesto.
Lay the fish on the vegetables and bake until it flakes easily.
steps.tip: Thaw frozen fish overnight in the fridge and pat it very dry.
steps.label: Bake fish

steps.text: Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Mediterranean Fish Soup
summary: Rich tomato fish soup with fennel, saffron, mussels and fish, with garlic toast.

steps.text: Slice the fennel and onion thinly and sweat in olive oil with 2 garlic cloves until soft.
steps.label: Sweat vegetables

steps.text: Deglaze with wine, add tomatoes, stock and saffron and simmer.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Cut the fish into chunks, add to the soup with the shrimp and let it just poach.
steps.tip: No more boiling and barely any stirring now, so the fish stays in nice chunks.
steps.label: Poach fish

steps.text: Toast slices of baguette. Mix the mayonnaise with the remaining grated garlic.
Sprinkle the soup with parsley and serve with the garlic toast.

title: Brown Shrimp and Scrambled Egg on Rye
summary: North Sea shrimp on creamy scrambled eggs and dark rye with chives. A Hamburg fish market breakfast.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter over low heat, add the eggs and slowly push them into large, creamy curds with a spatula.
steps.tip: Low heat, and off the heat while still slightly wet. That keeps it creamy.
steps.label: Scrambled eggs

steps.text: Butter the bread and spread the eggs on top.
Top with the shrimp and a squeeze of lemon and sprinkle with chives.

title: Braided Sweet Bread
summary: Fluffy, lightly sweet braided yeast bread with pearl sugar. As essential to Easter breakfast as colored eggs.

steps.text: Warm the milk and melt the butter in it. Knead with flour, yeast, sugar, 1 egg, lemon zest and salt for 10 minutes into a smooth, soft dough.
steps.tip: Long kneading pays off. The dough should look silky and pull away from the bowl.

steps.text: Let it rise covered in a warm place until doubled.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Divide into three pieces, roll into long ropes and braid. Press the ends together well.
Let it rise again on a tray. Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F).
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with pearl sugar and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake bread

steps.text: Cool on a rack. Serve with butter and jam.

title: Egg Salad with Cress
summary: Creamy egg salad with yogurt, mustard, pickle and fresh cress. Perfect for leftover Easter eggs.

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
steps.tip: Eggs a few days old peel much more easily than very fresh ones.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Roughly chop the eggs, finely dice the pickles, snip the chives.
Mix yogurt, mayonnaise and mustard, season with salt and pepper.
Gently combine everything, spread on bread and sprinkle with cress.

title: Spring Quiche with Asparagus and Goat Cheese
summary: Crispy quiche with green asparagus, peas and creamy goat cheese. Perfect for Easter brunch.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Line a tart pan with the pastry, prick with a fork and blind-bake.
steps.tip: Blind-baking prevents a soggy bottom.
steps.label: Blind-bake

steps.text: Cut the asparagus into pieces and blanch with the peas for 3 minutes.
steps.label: Blanch

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spread the vegetables and spring onions over the base, crumble the goat cheese over, pour in the egg mixture.
Bake until the filling is just set. Sprinkle with mint.
steps.label: Bake quiche

title: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
summary: Moist carrot cake with nuts and cinnamon under a cream cheese frosting. The Easter cake.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Finely grate the carrots.
Beat the eggs with sugar until foamy, pour in the oil. Stir in flour, nuts, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, then the carrots.
Pour into a greased springform pan and bake.
steps.tip: Skewer test: if no batter sticks to a wooden skewer, it's done.
steps.label: Bake cake

steps.text: Let it cool completely.
Beat cream cheese with soft butter, powdered sugar and lemon zest until creamy and spread over the cake.

title: Pumpkin Gnocchi with Sage Butter
summary: Homemade orange gnocchi of pumpkin and potato in brown sage butter.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Bake the pumpkin in wedges and the potatoes in their skins until soft.
steps.tip: Oven instead of water: the pumpkin stays dry and you need less flour.
steps.label: Bake pumpkin

steps.text: Peel the potatoes and press through a ricer with the pumpkin. Let cool a little.
Quickly knead with egg, flour, half the Parmesan, nutmeg and salt into a soft dough. Roll into ropes and cut into pieces.
Cook the gnocchi in simmering salted water until they float.
steps.label: Cook gnocchi

steps.text: Brown the butter with sage, toss the gnocchi in it and serve with the remaining Parmesan.

title: Pumpkin Pie
summary: American pumpkin pie with a silky, spiced filling of pumpkin, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg.

steps.text: Dice the pumpkin and steam covered with a little water until soft. Drain, purée smooth and cool.
steps.label: Steam pumpkin

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Line a tart pan with the pastry and blind-bake.
steps.label: Blind-bake

steps.text: Whisk the pumpkin purée with eggs, cream, sugar, spices and salt until smooth and pour into the pan.
Turn the oven down to 170 °C (340 °F) and bake until the center only wobbles slightly.
steps.tip: It may still jiggle a little in the middle. It sets as it cools.
steps.label: Bake pie

steps.text: Cool completely and serve with whipped cream.

title: Mummy Sausages
summary: Sausages wrapped in puff pastry strips with mustard eyes. Halloween fun for all ages.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Cut the puff pastry into thin strips.
Wrap the sausages crisscross with the strips, leaving a narrow gap at the top for the face.
steps.tip: Wrap them messily. The more chaotic, the more authentic the mummy.

steps.text: Brush with egg and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake mummies

steps.text: Dot on two mustard eyes. Serve with ketchup and vegetable sticks.

title: Roasted Pumpkin with Feta and Honey
summary: Pumpkin wedges roasted with rosemary, with feta, honey, walnuts and chili. Simple and stunning.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Seed the pumpkin and cut into wedges, cut the onion into wedges.
Toss with oil, rosemary, salt and pepper on a tray and roast until the edges caramelize.
steps.tip: Don't crowd the tray! Spaced out, the pumpkin roasts; crowded, it only steams.
steps.label: Roast pumpkin

steps.text: Add the walnuts to the tray for the last 5 minutes.
Arrange on arugula, crumble over the feta, drizzle with honey and chili. Serve with baguette.

title: Vanilla Crescents
summary: Tender almond crescents that melt on the tongue, rolled in vanilla sugar. The classic Christmas cookie.

steps.text: Quickly knead flour, almonds, cold butter in pieces, sugar, egg yolks and salt into a smooth dough.
Wrap in plastic and chill.
steps.tip: Cold dough is much easier to shape and the crescents keep their form.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Roll the dough into finger-thick ropes, cut into 5 cm pieces and bend into crescents.
Bake on baking paper until the tips are lightly browned.
steps.label: Bake crescents

steps.text: Mix powdered sugar with vanilla sugar and gently roll the still-warm crescents in it.
steps.tip: Roll them warm, but gently: fresh from the oven they're very fragile.

title: Cinnamon Stars
summary: Chewy almond cinnamon stars with snow-white meringue icing. Completely flourless.

steps.text: Beat the egg whites until stiff, gradually add the powdered sugar until glossy. Set aside 4 tbsp for the icing.
Knead the almonds, cinnamon and a little lemon zest into the rest. Chill the dough for 30 minutes.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Roll out 1 cm thick on powdered sugar and cut out stars. Brush thinly with the icing.
steps.tip: Keep dipping the cutter in water so the dough doesn't stick.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 150 °C (300 °F) and bake the stars until the icing is set but still white.
steps.label: Bake stars

steps.text: Cool on the tray. They keep for weeks in a tin.

title: Candied Almonds
summary: Crunchy caramelized almonds with cinnamon that smell like a Christmas market. Done in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Bring sugar, vanilla sugar, cinnamon and 100 ml water to a boil in a nonstick pan.
Add the almonds and cook, stirring constantly, until the water evaporates and the sugar turns dry and crumbly.
steps.label: Cook down

steps.text: Keep stirring until the sugar melts again and coats the almonds in a glossy shell.
steps.tip: Don't stop stirring! First it turns sandy, then suddenly glossy. That's exactly right.
steps.label: Caramelize

steps.text: Spread on baking paper right away and separate with two forks. Let cool.

title: Speculoos Tiramisu
summary: Christmassy tiramisu with speculoos cookies, mascarpone, orange and cinnamon. No raw eggs.

steps.text: Brew the coffee, mix with the orange juice and let cool.
Stir mascarpone, quark, sugar, orange zest and cinnamon until smooth.
steps.tip: Quark instead of eggs makes the cream lighter and keeps longer.

steps.text: Dip the speculoos briefly in the coffee and layer in glasses or a dish, alternating with the cream.
Chill for at least 3 hours and dust with cocoa and crushed speculoos before serving.

title: Fondue Chinoise
summary: Thinly sliced meat and vegetables cooked at the table in hot broth, with colorful dips. Cozy for New Year's Eve.

steps.text: Bring the stock to a boil with sliced ginger, spring onions and soy sauce and let it infuse.
steps.label: Infuse broth

steps.text: Arrange the meat on platters, cut the vegetables into bite-size pieces.
steps.tip: Ask the butcher to slice the meat paper-thin, or slice it yourself half-frozen.

steps.text: Mix the dips: mayonnaise with curry and a little ketchup, plus the cocktail sauce.
Set the broth on the burner. Everyone cooks meat and vegetables in a basket or on a fork.
At the end, drink the flavorful broth as soup.

title: Layered Party Salad
summary: The party classic in a glass bowl: leek, egg, corn, peas, ham, cheese and dressing in layers.

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs, blanch the peas briefly and let cool.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Slice the leek thinly, shred the lettuce, dice the eggs and ham.
Mix mayonnaise with yogurt, salt and pepper.
Layer in a glass bowl: lettuce, leek, eggs, corn, peas, ham. Cover with dressing and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and let it sit for several hours or overnight. Sprinkle with chives.
steps.tip: Overnight the leek mellows and everything comes together.

title: Blini with Smoked Salmon
summary: Little fluffy pancakes with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill. Finger food for New Year's Eve.

steps.text: Mix flour, baking powder and salt. Stir in milk, egg and 20 g melted butter to a thick batter.
Wipe a pan with a little butter and cook small blini by the tablespoon, flipping when bubbles appear.
steps.tip: Keep the pan on medium. Too hot and they burn outside while staying raw inside.
steps.label: Cook blini

steps.text: Mix the crème fraîche with lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Let the blini cool, top each with a dollop of crème fraîche, a piece of salmon and dill.

title: Chocolate Mousse
summary: Airy, deep dark chocolate mousse from just four ingredients.

steps.text: Melt the chocolate over a warm water bath and let it cool a little.
Separate the eggs. Stir the yolks into the chocolate.
Whip the cream to soft peaks. Beat the egg whites with salt and sugar until stiff.
Gently fold first the cream, then the egg whites in two batches into the chocolate.
steps.tip: Beat in a little egg white first to loosen the chocolate. Then fold in the rest gently.

steps.text: Spoon into glasses and chill for at least 4 hours.

title: Crème Brûlée
summary: Silky vanilla custard under a cracking caramel crust.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 150 °C (300 °F). Heat the cream with the vanilla seeds and pod without boiling.
Stir the yolks with sugar (don't whip) and slowly whisk in the hot cream. Pour through a sieve.
steps.tip: Don't whip it frothy, or you'll get bubbles in the custard.

steps.text: Pour into shallow ramekins, set in a dish with hot water and bake until the custard only wobbles slightly in the center.
steps.label: Bake custard

steps.text: Cool and chill for at least 3 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle with brown sugar and caramelize with a torch or under a hot broiler.

title: Apple Crumble with Custard
summary: Warm cinnamon apples under crunchy oat crumble, with custard. Autumn in a baking dish.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Peel and dice the apples and put in a dish with lemon juice, cinnamon and 20 g sugar.
Rub flour, oats, remaining sugar and cold butter into crumbs and scatter over the apples.
Bake until the crumble is golden and the juices bubble.
steps.tip: A handful of chopped walnuts in the crumble makes it even crunchier.
steps.label: Bake crumble

steps.text: Cook the custard with milk and sugar as directed and serve warm with the crumble.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
summary: Little chocolate cakes with a molten center. Look spectacular and are ready in 25 minutes.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Butter four ramekins and dust with cocoa.
Melt the chocolate with the butter.
Beat eggs, yolks, sugar and salt until pale, stir in the chocolate, fold in the flour.
Fill the ramekins and bake until the edges are set but the center is still soft.
steps.tip: Better a minute too short. The molten center is the whole magic.
steps.label: Bake cakes

steps.text: Rest for 1 minute, turn out onto plates and serve with vanilla ice cream.

title: Waffles with Hot Cherries
summary: Crispy butter waffles with hot cherries and cream. A homemade Sunday afternoon.

steps.text: Beat soft butter with sugar and vanilla sugar until creamy, beat in the eggs one at a time.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt alternately with the milk.
Bring the cherries to a boil with their juice and thicken with the starch mixed in water.
steps.label: Cook cherries

steps.text: Preheat the waffle iron, grease lightly and bake the waffles until golden.
steps.tip: Lay the waffles side by side on a rack, don't stack them. They stay crisp.
steps.label: Bake waffles

steps.text: Whip the cream and serve with the hot cherries and waffles.

title: Semolina Pudding with Cinnamon and Compote
summary: Creamy semolina pudding like childhood, with cinnamon sugar, brown butter and berry compote.

steps.text: Bring the milk to a boil with 2 tbsp sugar, vanilla sugar and salt.
Sprinkle in the semolina, stirring constantly, and let it thicken over low heat.
steps.tip: Keep stirring, semolina pudding burns easily.
steps.label: Cook semolina

steps.text: Bring the berries to a boil briefly with a little sugar.
steps.label: Compote

steps.text: Brown the butter. Mix the remaining sugar with cinnamon.
Serve the pudding with brown butter, cinnamon sugar and compote.

title: Banana Bread
summary: Moist banana bread with walnuts and cinnamon. The best use for brown bananas.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Grease a loaf pan. Melt the butter.
Mash the bananas with a fork, mix with butter, sugar and eggs.
steps.tip: The browner the bananas, the sweeter and moister the bread.

steps.text: Briefly stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and chopped walnuts.
Pour into the pan and bake until a wooden skewer comes out clean.
steps.label: Bake banana bread

steps.text: Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out.

title: Plum Sheet Cake
summary: Bavarian sheet cake with yeast dough, packed with plums and butter crumble.

steps.text: Knead 300 g flour, yeast, 50 g sugar, egg, 50 g soft butter, lukewarm milk and salt into a smooth dough. Let it rise.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Wash and pit the plums and slit them lengthwise so they open up.
Roll out the dough on a tray. Arrange the plums tightly like roof tiles, cut side up.
steps.tip: Pack them really tight! The plums shrink while baking.

steps.text: Rub the remaining flour, 130 g cold butter, 110 g sugar and cinnamon into crumbs and scatter over. Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Bake until golden. Serve lukewarm with whipped cream.
steps.label: Bake cake

title: Strawberry Tiramisu
summary: Summery tiramisu with fresh strawberries, lemon mascarpone and ladyfingers soaked in strawberry juice.

steps.text: Purée half the strawberries with orange juice and 20 g sugar.
Slice the remaining strawberries.
Beat mascarpone, quark, remaining sugar, vanilla sugar and lemon zest until creamy.
Dip the ladyfingers briefly in the strawberry purée and layer alternately with cream and strawberry slices.
steps.tip: Save the leftover purée as a sauce and drizzle over when serving.

steps.text: Chill for at least 3 hours.

title: Yeast Dumplings with Poppy Seed Butter
summary: Fluffy steamed yeast dumplings filled with plum butter, with poppy seed sugar and melted butter. A ski hut classic.

steps.text: Knead flour, yeast, 30 g sugar, egg, 40 g soft butter, lukewarm milk and salt into a smooth dough. Let it rise.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Divide into 4, flatten, put 1 tbsp plum butter in the middle of each, seal well and shape into balls.
steps.tip: Seal well, or the plum butter leaks out during steaming.

steps.text: Let them rise again.
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: Steam covered in a steamer basket over boiling water. Don't lift the lid!
steps.label: Steam dumplings

steps.text: Melt the remaining butter, mix the poppy seeds with powdered sugar. Pour butter over the dumplings and sprinkle with poppy seed sugar.

title: Baked Eggs with Spinach
summary: Eggs baked in creamy spinach with feta and chili. The easiest star of any Easter brunch.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Fry garlic and spring onions in oil, add the spinach and let it wilt.
Stir in cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper and transfer to a small baking dish.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, crumble over the feta.
Bake until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
steps.tip: Watch closely near the end. One minute decides runny or firm.
steps.label: Bake eggs

steps.text: Sprinkle with chili and serve with toasted bread.

title: Baked Apple Crumble with Gingerbread
summary: Christmassy crumble of apples, raisins and marzipan under gingerbread crumbs.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Dice the apples and put in a dish with raisins, cinnamon and crumbled marzipan.
Crumble the gingerbread finely and rub with flour, sugar and cold butter into crumbs.
steps.tip: Leftover gingerbread? Perfect for this!

steps.text: Scatter the crumble over the apples and bake until crunchy and bubbling.
steps.label: Bake crumble

steps.text: Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Dumpling Lasagna
summary: The viral hit of 2026: wonton wrappers, napa cabbage and ginger pork layered and steamed. Tastes like dumplings, no folding.

steps.text: Finely chop the cabbage, salt, let sit 10 minutes and squeeze out hard.
steps.label: Salt cabbage

steps.text: Mix the pork with cabbage, grated ginger and garlic, spring onions, 2 tbsp soy and sesame oil.
Oil a heatproof dish. Layer wrappers (slightly overlapping) and filling, finishing with wrappers.
steps.tip: Brush the top layer with a little water so it stays soft instead of drying out.

steps.text: Cover with foil and steam (or bake at 180 °C / 355 °F in a water bath) until the meat is cooked through.
steps.label: Steam

steps.text: Mix the remaining soy with vinegar and chili oil, drizzle over and cut into squares.

title: Egg Katsu
summary: Viral comfort food: soft-boiled eggs in a crispy panko coating, with rice, cabbage and katsu sauce. The yolk runs.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook covered with 200 ml water.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Boil 4 eggs for exactly 6 minutes, shock in ice water and peel carefully.
steps.tip: Well-chilled eggs survive breading and frying without the yolk setting.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Dredge the eggs in flour, the fifth beaten egg and panko. Do egg and panko twice for an extra crust.
Fry in 2 cm of hot oil until golden all over.
steps.label: Fry eggs

steps.text: Stir ketchup, Worcestershire and soy into katsu sauce. Halve the eggs and serve with rice, shredded cabbage and sauce.

title: Charcuterie Dip
summary: The whole cheese board in one bowl: cheese, salami, olives and tomatoes chopped small, with balsamic. Scoop up with crackers.

steps.text: Cut the cheese, salami, olives, pepperoncini and tomatoes into equally small dice.
steps.tip: Cutting everything the same small size is the trick: every cracker gets a bit of everything.

steps.text: Toss in a bowl with olive oil, balsamic, oregano and pepper.
Tear basil over the top and serve cold with crackers.

title: Giant Chicken Parm
summary: Ground chicken rolled out thin like a pizza base, breaded, baked under tomato sauce and mozzarella. Viral in autumn 2026.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Mix the chicken with salt, pepper and grated garlic.
Roll out between two sheets of baking paper into a large thin circle (about 30 cm). Peel off the top sheet.
steps.tip: Baking paper is your best friend here. The sticky mince rolls out effortlessly.

steps.text: Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with panko and Parmesan and press on. Flip using the paper and coat the other side the same way.
Drizzle with oil and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake

steps.text: Top with tomato sauce, oregano and mozzarella and bake until bubbling. Top with arugula and cut like a pizza.
steps.label: Bake with cheese

title: Earl Grey Yogurt Toast
summary: Thick yogurt infused overnight with Earl Grey, spread on toast with honey and berries. An autumn 2026 trend.

steps.text: Grind the tea finely and stir into the yogurt with 1 tbsp honey.
steps.tip: Grinding finely matters, or the tea leaves will be gritty.

steps.text: Drain overnight in the fridge in a sieve lined with a kitchen towel.
Toast the bread and spread thickly with the yogurt.
Top with berries, chopped pistachios, remaining honey and a pinch of salt.

title: Yogurt Tiramisu with Caramel Biscuits
summary: The light trending version: Greek yogurt instead of mascarpone, caramel biscuits soaked in coffee, cocoa on top.

steps.text: Stir the yogurt smooth with honey and vanilla sugar.
Dip the biscuits briefly in cold coffee and lay a layer in a small dish.
Alternate layers of yogurt and biscuits, finishing with yogurt.
steps.tip: Overnight the biscuits turn soft like sponge cake. A little patience pays off.

steps.text: Chill for at least 2 hours and dust with cocoa.

title: Cottage Cheese Tacos
summary: Taco shells made from baked cottage cheese, crispy and high in protein, filled with scrambled eggs, avocado and salsa.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Blend the cottage cheese with 1 egg, grated cheese and paprika until smooth.
Spread 4 thin circles on baking paper and bake until golden and firm.
steps.tip: The edges should get properly brown, only then will they come off the paper.
steps.label: Bake shells

steps.text: While still warm, drape over a wooden spoon handle so they take on a taco shape.
Scramble the remaining eggs. Dice the tomato and avocado, mix with lime and cilantro.
steps.label: Scrambled eggs

steps.text: Fill the shells with scrambled eggs and avocado salsa.

title: Berry Cookie Cobbler
summary: Hot, jammy berries baked under cookie dough. Half crumble, half cookie. A summer 2026 trend.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Toss the berries with starch, 1 tbsp sugar and lemon zest in a dish.
Beat soft butter with the remaining sugar, beat in the egg, then mix in flour, baking soda, salt and chocolate chips.
Drop the dough in spoonfuls over the berries.
steps.tip: Leave gaps! That's where the berry juice bubbles through and caramelizes.

steps.text: Bake until the cookies are golden and the berries bubble.
steps.label: Bake cobbler

steps.text: Cool briefly and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Cottage Cheese Alfredo Pasta
summary: Creamy pasta sauce of blended cottage cheese, Parmesan and garlic. High in protein yet silky.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Blend the cottage cheese with Parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, pepper and a squeeze of lemon until completely smooth.
steps.tip: Blend for a good while until no curds remain. Then the sauce is like cream.

steps.text: Cook the fettuccine, adding the spinach for the last minute.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Drain the pasta and spinach, return to the pot with butter, stir in the sauce and a splash of pasta water. Don't boil again.
Serve with pepper and Parmesan.

title: Gochujang Brussels Sprouts
summary: Crispy roasted Brussels sprouts with a sweet and spicy gochujang honey glaze and sesame. Converts even sprout haters.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Trim and halve the sprouts, toss with oil and salt and place cut side down on a tray.
steps.tip: Cut side down: it turns deep golden and nutty instead of bitter.

steps.text: Roast until the edges are dark and crispy.
steps.label: Roast sprouts

steps.text: Stir together gochujang, honey, soy, vinegar and grated garlic.
Toss the sprouts in the glaze, sprinkle with sesame and spring onions and serve with rice.

title: Harissa Honey Carrots with Yogurt
summary: Whole carrots roasted with a spicy-sweet harissa honey glaze on garlic yogurt and feta.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (410 °F). Peel the carrots and halve the large ones lengthwise.
Mix harissa, honey, olive oil and salt and rub over the carrots.
Roast on a tray until tender and caramelized at the edges.
steps.tip: Turn halfway through and brush with the glaze from the tray.
steps.label: Roast carrots

steps.text: Mix yogurt with grated garlic, lemon juice and salt and spread on a platter.
Lay the carrots on top, scatter with feta, pistachios and mint. Serve with flatbread.

title: Korean Beef Bowl
summary: Sweet and savory ground beef with soy, garlic and sesame over rice, with a fried egg and cucumber. In 20 minutes.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Fry the beef in a hot pan without fat until crumbly and crisp.
steps.tip: Only stir once a brown crust has formed underneath.
steps.label: Fry beef

steps.text: Grate the garlic and ginger and fry briefly. Stir in soy, sugar, gochujang and sesame oil and let it reduce.
steps.label: Glaze

steps.text: Fry the eggs, slice the cucumber.
steps.label: Fried eggs

steps.text: Rice in bowls, beef on top, finish with egg, cucumber, spring onions and sesame.

title: Dubai Chocolate Strawberry Cups
summary: The viral dessert hit: strawberries under crispy kadayif with pistachio cream and melted chocolate.

steps.text: Pull the kadayif into small pieces and toast in butter until golden and crispy. Let cool.
steps.tip: Keep stirring, kadayif goes from golden to burnt very quickly.
steps.label: Toast kadayif

steps.text: Mix the kadayif with pistachio cream and tahini.
Halve the strawberries and put them in glasses or a small dish. Spread the pistachio kadayif on top.
Melt the chocolate, pour over and sprinkle with chopped pistachios. Let it set briefly.

title: Cabbage Steaks with Garlic Butter
summary: Thick cabbage slices roasted crisp in the oven, with Parmesan garlic butter. The vegetable trend from social media kitchens.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Cut the cabbage lengthwise into 4 thick slices, keeping the core attached.
steps.tip: The core holds the slices together. Don't cut it out!

steps.text: Melt the butter and mix with grated garlic, chili, salt and pepper. Brush over the cabbage.
Roast on a tray until the edges are crispy and brown. Turn halfway.
steps.label: Roast cabbage

steps.text: Warm the beans with olive oil, lemon juice and parsley.
Sprinkle the cabbage steaks with Parmesan, bake briefly and serve on the beans.
steps.label: Bake Parmesan

title: Marry Me Chicken
summary: The internet's evergreen: chicken in a creamy sauce of sun-dried tomatoes, Parmesan and basil.

steps.text: Halve the chicken horizontally, season and fry in 1 tbsp of the tomato oil until golden on each side. Remove.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Briefly fry garlic, chopped tomatoes, chili and oregano in the fat.
Pour in stock and cream, stir in the Parmesan, return the chicken and simmer.
steps.tip: The oil from the tomato jar adds far more flavor than plain oil.
steps.label: Simmer

steps.text: Cook the tagliatelle.
steps.label: Cook tagliatelle

steps.text: Tear basil over the top and serve with the pasta.

title: Smashed Potatoes with Herb Dip
summary: Small potatoes boiled, smashed flat and baked crisp in the oven. Chips outside, creamy inside.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, drain and let steam dry.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 230 °C (445 °F). Place the potatoes on an oiled tray and smash flat with the bottom of a glass.
steps.tip: The more ragged edges, the more crunch.

steps.text: Drizzle with olive oil, top with garlic, rosemary and salt and bake until crispy.
steps.label: Bake potatoes

steps.text: Mix the sour cream with chives, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle the potatoes with Parmesan and serve with the dip.

title: German Cheesecake
summary: Classic German cheesecake with quark, a shortcrust base and a hint of lemon. Creamy, not heavy.

steps.text: Quickly knead flour, 100 g cold butter, 70 g sugar, 1 egg, baking powder and salt. Line a springform pan with it, pressing 3 cm up the sides. Chill.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 170 °C (340 °F). Melt the remaining butter.
Whisk quark, remaining sugar, 3 eggs, pudding powder, milk, melted butter and lemon zest until smooth. Pour onto the base.
steps.tip: Just stir, don't whip. Too much air makes the cake rise and then crack.

steps.text: Bake until the center is just set.
steps.label: Bake cheesecake

steps.text: Turn off the oven and leave the cake inside with the door ajar for 15 minutes. Then cool completely.
steps.tip: Slow cooling is the trick against cracks.

title: Covered Apple Pie
summary: Juicy cinnamon apples between two layers of shortcrust, with icing. Straight from Grandma's kitchen.

steps.text: Knead flour, cold butter, egg, 100 g sugar, baking powder and salt into a shortcrust dough. Chill.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Peel and slice the apples, briefly stew with lemon juice, remaining sugar, cinnamon and raisins. Let cool.
steps.tip: Pre-cooking briefly stops a gap forming under the lid later.
steps.label: Stew apples

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Press two thirds of the dough into a springform pan (with a rim) and fill with the apples.
Roll out the remaining dough, place on top as a lid and prick several times. Bake.
steps.label: Bake pie

steps.text: Stir powdered sugar with a little lemon juice into an icing and spread over the still-warm cake.

title: Moist Chocolate Cake
summary: Simple chocolate loaf with cocoa and chocolate, moist inside, with a glossy chocolate glaze.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Grease a loaf pan.
Beat the eggs with sugar until foamy, stir in oil and milk. Fold in flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt. Fold in 50 g chopped chocolate.
steps.tip: Oil instead of butter keeps the cake moist for days.

steps.text: Pour into the pan and bake.
steps.label: Bake cake

steps.text: Heat the cream, melt the remaining chocolate in it and stir smooth.
Let the cake cool and cover with the glaze.

title: Fudgy Brownies
summary: Dense, chocolatey brownies with a crackly, shiny top and gooey center.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Line a 20 cm square pan with baking paper.
Melt the chocolate with the butter.
Beat the eggs with sugar vigorously for 3 minutes until pale. Stir in the chocolate.
steps.tip: Beating the eggs and sugar for a long time creates the signature shiny, crackly top.

steps.text: Fold in flour, cocoa and salt, mix in the walnuts, pour into the pan.
Bake until the edges are set and moist crumbs still cling to a skewer in the center.
steps.label: Bake brownies

steps.text: Cool completely, then cut.

title: Lemon Drizzle Cake
summary: Moist loaf cake with lots of lemon, soaked with lemon syrup and a crisp sugar glaze.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Grease a loaf pan.
Beat soft butter with sugar and lemon zest until creamy, beat in the eggs one at a time. Fold in flour, baking powder and salt.
Pour into the pan and bake.
steps.label: Bake cake

steps.text: Prick the still-hot cake all over with a skewer and drizzle with half the lemon juice.
steps.tip: The juice soaks into the holes and makes the cake incredibly moist.

steps.text: Stir powdered sugar with remaining lemon juice into a thick glaze and pour over the cooled cake.

title: Marble Cake
summary: The birthday classic: light and dark batter swirled together, with chocolate glaze.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Grease a bundt pan and dust with flour.
Beat butter with sugar and vanilla sugar until creamy, beat in eggs one at a time. Stir in flour, baking powder, salt and 70 ml milk.
Pour two thirds into the pan. Mix the rest of the batter with cocoa and remaining milk and spread on top.
Swirl through with a fork in a spiral.
steps.tip: Swirl only once. Too much and you get a uniformly brown cake.

steps.text: Bake, cool, turn out and cover with melted couverture.
steps.label: Bake cake

title: Crumb Sheet Cake
summary: Fluffy yeast dough under a thick layer of buttery crumbs. Simple and irresistible.

steps.text: Knead 350 g flour, yeast, 50 g sugar, egg, 50 g soft butter, lukewarm milk and salt into a smooth dough. Let rise.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Roll out the dough on a greased tray.
Rub the remaining flour, remaining sugar, vanilla sugar, cinnamon and 250 g melted, cooled butter with your fingers into coarse crumbs.
steps.tip: Melted butter makes big, crunchy crumbs. Leave some really chunky ones!

steps.text: Scatter the crumbs over the dough and let rise briefly again. Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F).
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: Bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake cake

title: Blueberry Muffins
summary: Fluffy muffins with lots of blueberries and a crunchy sugar crust. Quickly mixed.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Line a muffin tray with paper cases.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and lemon zest. Whisk eggs, buttermilk and oil.
Stir wet and dry together just briefly, fold in the blueberries.
steps.tip: Toss the blueberries in a little flour first so they don't sink to the bottom.

steps.text: Fill the cases, sprinkle with brown sugar and bake.
steps.label: Bake muffins

title: Cinnamon Rolls
summary: Soft yeast rolls with cinnamon butter filling and cream cheese glaze.

steps.text: Knead flour, yeast, sugar, egg, 50 g soft butter, lukewarm milk and salt into a soft dough. Let rise.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread with 80 g soft butter, sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll up from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack tightly in a dish and let rise.
steps.tip: Cut with dental floss instead of a knife: the rolls stay round.
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F) and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake rolls

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese with remaining butter and powdered sugar and spread over the warm rolls.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
summary: Crispy outside, chewy inside, with chocolate chunks and a pinch of sea salt.

steps.text: Melt the butter and brown it lightly, then let it cool.
steps.tip: Brown butter gives the cookies a caramel, nutty flavor.

steps.text: Mix the butter with both sugars and vanilla sugar, beat in the egg. Stir in flour, baking soda and salt, fold in chopped chocolate.
Chill the dough covered.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Place walnut-size balls well apart on a tray and bake until the edges are golden and the center still soft.
steps.label: Bake cookies

steps.text: Sprinkle with sea salt right away and cool on the tray.

title: Soft Pretzels
summary: Homemade pretzels with a shiny crust and coarse salt, using a baking soda bath instead of lye.

steps.text: Knead flour, yeast, sugar, salt, soft butter and 300 ml lukewarm water for 10 minutes into a firm dough. Let rise.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Divide into 8 pieces, roll into thin ropes with a thick middle and twist into pretzels.
Place uncovered in the fridge for 15 minutes so a skin forms.
steps.tip: The skin creates the classic smooth, shiny crust.
steps.label: Chill

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Boil 2 liters water with the baking soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.
Place on baking paper, score the thick part, sprinkle with coarse salt and bake until deep brown.
steps.label: Bake pretzels

title: Scones with Clotted Cream
summary: British tea scones, golden outside, fluffy inside, with jam and thick cream.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, rub in the cold butter with your fingers until it looks like sand.
Stir in the milk and press briefly into a soft dough.
steps.tip: Knead as little as possible. That makes scones light and tall.

steps.text: Pat out 3 cm thick and cut circles without twisting the cutter.
Brush with beaten egg and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake scones

steps.text: Split while warm and serve with jam and clotted cream.

title: Pavlova with Berries
summary: Crisp meringue with a soft marshmallow center, topped with cream and fresh berries.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 120 °C (250 °F). Beat the egg whites with salt until stiff, add the sugar a spoonful at a time and keep beating until glossy and the sugar has dissolved.
steps.tip: Rub between your fingers: if it no longer feels gritty, the sugar has dissolved.

steps.text: Fold in the starch and vinegar.
Shape into a 20 cm circle with a raised rim on baking paper and dry in the oven.
steps.label: Dry meringue

steps.text: Let it cool completely in the switched-off oven.
Just before serving, top with whipped cream, berries and mint.

title: Strawberry Tart with Vanilla Cream
summary: Sponge base with vanilla custard and fresh strawberries under a glaze. The quintessential summer cake.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Beat the eggs with 100 g sugar and 2 tbsp warm water until very foamy. Gently fold in flour, starch and baking powder.
steps.tip: Beat for at least 5 minutes. The air in the eggs is what really makes it rise.

steps.text: Pour into a fruit flan pan and bake. Cool and turn out.
steps.label: Bake base

steps.text: Cook the pudding with the milk and remaining sugar, cool slightly and spread over the base.
steps.label: Cook pudding

steps.text: Halve the strawberries and arrange them tightly on top.
Prepare the glaze as directed and spoon over the strawberries from the center out. Chill.

title: Linzer Torte
summary: Spiced nut shortcrust with redcurrant jam and a lattice top. Gets even better after a few days.

steps.text: Quickly knead flour, nuts, cold butter, sugar, egg, spices, cocoa and lemon zest into a dough. Chill.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Press two thirds of the dough into a tart pan.
Stir the jam smooth and spread over, leaving a 1 cm border.
Roll the remaining dough into thin ropes and lay over as a lattice.
steps.tip: Lattice tearing? Just press it back together. The dough is very forgiving.

steps.text: Bake, cool and dust with powdered sugar. Best left to mature for 2 days.
steps.label: Bake torte

title: Quark Stollen
summary: Moist Christmas stollen made with quark instead of yeast, full of raisins, almonds and candied peel. Ready in an hour.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Soak the raisins in hot water for 10 minutes and drain.
Knead flour, baking powder, sugar, vanilla sugar, salt, quark, egg, lemon zest and 125 g soft butter. Work in the raisins, almonds and candied peel.
Shape into an oval, press a groove lengthwise and fold one half over to get the classic stollen shape.
Bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake stollen

steps.text: Melt the remaining butter, brush over the hot stollen and dust thickly with powdered sugar.
steps.tip: Wrapped in foil, it keeps for two weeks and gets moister every day.

title: Butter Cut-Out Cookies
summary: Tender butter cookies cut into stars, hearts and trees, colorfully decorated. An Advent afternoon with kids.

steps.text: Quickly knead flour, cold butter, sugar, egg yolks, vanilla sugar and salt. Chill wrapped in plastic.
steps.tip: Roll the dough between two sheets of baking paper so nothing sticks and you need no extra flour.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Roll the dough 3 mm thick and cut out shapes.
Bake on baking paper until pale golden.
steps.label: Bake cookies

steps.text: Stir powdered sugar with lemon juice into icing, spread on the cooled cookies and decorate with sprinkles.

title: Coconut Macaroons
summary: Golden outside, moist inside: coconut macaroons from just three ingredients. The perfect use for egg whites.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160 °C (320 °F). Beat the egg whites with salt until stiff, sprinkle in sugar and vanilla sugar.
Gently fold in the coconut.
Use two teaspoons to place small heaps on baking paper.
steps.tip: Placed on edible wafer paper, they come off especially easily.

steps.text: Bake until the tips are golden.
steps.label: Bake macaroons

steps.text: Let cool and drizzle with melted chocolate.

title: Egg Liqueur Cake
summary: Super fluffy bundt cake with egg liqueur in the batter. Belongs on every Easter coffee table.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Grease a bundt pan and dust with flour.
Beat the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until pale and thick. Slowly stir in the oil and egg liqueur.
Gently fold in flour and baking powder, pour into the pan.
Bake until a wooden skewer comes out clean.
steps.tip: Most of the alcohol bakes off, the flavor stays.
steps.label: Bake cake

steps.text: Let cool, turn out and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Franzbrötchen
summary: Hamburg cinnamon pastries made from puff pastry, filled with butter and cinnamon sugar, pressed flat and caramelized.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Unroll the puff pastry and spread with soft butter.
Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over. Roll up from the long side.
Cut into 8 pieces. Press each firmly in the middle with a wooden spoon handle so the spiral bursts out at the sides.
steps.tip: Press hard. That burst-open shape is what makes a Franzbrötchen.
