steps.text: Brush with egg and bake until golden and caramelized.
steps.label: Bake

title: Apple Strudel with Vanilla Sauce
summary: Paper-thin pastry around cinnamon apples, raisins and buttery crumbs. The Viennese classic with warm vanilla sauce.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Toast the breadcrumbs in 30 g butter until golden.
Peel and thinly slice the apples, mix with sugar, cinnamon, raisins and lemon juice.
Lay the pastry sheets on a towel and brush with melted butter. Scatter the crumbs on the lower third, apples on top.
steps.tip: The crumbs soak up the apple juice and keep the pastry crisp.

steps.text: Roll up using the towel, place on a tray, brush with butter and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake strudel

steps.text: Cook the vanilla sauce as directed. Dust the strudel with powdered sugar and serve warm.

title: Danube Wave Cake
summary: Marbled sheet cake with sour cherries, buttercream and chocolate waves. The coffee-table masterpiece.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Beat 250 g butter with 250 g sugar until creamy, beat in the eggs one at a time, stir in flour and baking powder.
Spread half on a greased tray. Mix the rest with cocoa and 50 ml milk and spread on top. Press in the drained cherries and bake.
steps.label: Bake base

steps.text: Cook the pudding with 500 ml milk and remaining sugar and cool to room temperature covered with plastic wrap.
steps.tip: Butter and pudding must be exactly the same temperature, or the buttercream curdles.
steps.label: Cook pudding

steps.text: Beat the remaining soft butter until fluffy and beat in the pudding a spoonful at a time. Spread on the cold cake and chill.
Melt the couverture with coconut oil, spread over and draw waves with a fork. Let it set.

title: Easter Lamb Cake
summary: Fluffy lemon sponge cake shaped like a lamb, dusted with powdered sugar. The centerpiece of the Easter table.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F). Grease the lamb mold thoroughly and dust with flour.
steps.tip: Grease every crevice, especially the ears and head. Otherwise the lamb sticks.

steps.text: Beat butter, sugar and lemon zest until creamy, beat in the eggs one at a time.
Stir in flour, starch, baking powder and salt with the milk. Fill the mold.
Bake until a wooden skewer comes out clean.
steps.label: Bake lamb

steps.text: Rest in the mold for 10 minutes, release carefully and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Quick Spelt Seed Bread
summary: Moist bread of spelt flour with sunflower seeds, flaxseed and oats. No kneading, baked in a loaf pan.

steps.text: Mix flour, yeast, salt, seeds and oats (keep some back for the top).
Stir in 500 ml lukewarm water, vinegar and honey until you have a sticky dough.
steps.tip: The splash of vinegar makes the crumb moist and keeps the bread fresh longer.

steps.text: Pour into a greased loaf pan, sprinkle with seeds and put into the cold oven.
Turn the oven to 200 °C (390 °F) and bake until the bread sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
steps.label: Bake bread

steps.text: Remove from the pan right away and cool on a rack.

title: Asparagus Risotto with Lemon
summary: Creamy risotto with green asparagus, lemon zest and Parmesan. Spring on a plate.

steps.text: Peel the lower part of the asparagus and trim woody ends. Cut off the tips, slice the stalks. Keep the stock hot.
Finely dice the onion and sweat in oil until translucent. Add the rice, toast for 1 minute, deglaze with the wine.
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring. After 10 minutes add the asparagus pieces, the tips only 5 minutes before the end.
steps.tip: Simmer the asparagus peelings in the stock for a while. It adds far more asparagus flavor.
steps.label: Stir risotto

steps.text: Take off the heat, stir in butter, Parmesan and lemon zest, rest for 2 minutes. Season.

title: Wild Garlic Scrambled Eggs on Toast
summary: Soft scrambled eggs with fresh wild garlic on crispy sourdough. Ready in ten minutes.

steps.text: Wash the wild garlic and cut into thin strips. Toast the bread.
Whisk the eggs with sour cream, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter over medium heat, add the eggs and slowly push them together with a spatula.
steps.tip: Pull the pan off the heat while the eggs still look slightly runny. They keep cooking.

steps.text: Fold in the wild garlic and pile everything onto the toast.

title: Tarte Flambée with Green Asparagus
summary: Wafer-thin base with crème fraîche, green asparagus, red onions and goat cheese.

steps.text: Preheat the oven with a tray inside to 250 °C (480 °F).
Halve the asparagus lengthwise, slice the onion into thin rings.
Unroll the dough, spread with seasoned crème fraîche, top with asparagus, onions and crumbled cheese.
Bake on the hot tray until crisp. Drizzle with a little honey.
steps.tip: The preheated tray stands in for a pizza stone and makes the base truly crisp.
steps.label: Bake tarte

title: Roasted Asparagus with Parmesan and Egg
summary: Oven-roasted green asparagus with a Parmesan crust, jammy egg and potatoes.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Halve the potatoes, toss with 2 tbsp oil and salt on a tray and pre-roast.
steps.label: Pre-roast potatoes

steps.text: Add the asparagus with the remaining oil, grate Parmesan over it and keep roasting.
steps.label: Roast asparagus

steps.text: Boil the eggs, rinse under cold water and peel.
steps.tip: Seven minutes from going into boiling water gives a creamy, not runny yolk.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Plate everything, halve the eggs, sprinkle with lemon zest and pepper.

title: Spinach and Feta Börek
summary: Crispy filo spiral filled with spinach, feta and herbs. Delicious warm or cold.

steps.text: Thaw the spinach and squeeze firmly. Dice the onion and fry briefly. Mix with feta and parsley, add pepper.
steps.tip: Squeeze well. Every drop of water makes the pastry soggy later.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Whisk 1 egg, yogurt and oil.
Brush the pastry sheets with the yogurt mixture, lay the filling in a line, roll up and coil into a spiral in a dish.
Brush with the second egg, sprinkle with nigella seeds and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake börek

title: Pasta with Peas, Ricotta and Mint
summary: Springtime pasta with sweet peas, creamy ricotta, lemon and fresh mint.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Cook the pasta, adding the peas 3 minutes before the end. Reserve a cup of pasta water.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Gently sweat the garlic in oil. Stir ricotta, Parmesan, lemon zest and some pasta water until smooth.
Toss in the pasta and peas, season with lemon juice, mint, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Roughly crush a few peas. It helps the sauce cling.

title: New Potatoes with Herb Butter and Radishes
summary: Baby potatoes in their skins tossed in herb butter, with a crunchy radish and cucumber salad.

steps.text: Scrub the potatoes and boil in salted water.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Thinly slice radishes and cucumber, mix with vinegar, oil, salt and half the dill.
Melt the butter, finely chop the remaining herbs and stir in. Toss the potatoes in it.
steps.tip: Don't throw away the radish leaves. Finely chopped they're perfect in the herb butter.

title: Rhubarb Meringue Cake
summary: Moist sponge with tart rhubarb and a fluffy, lightly browned meringue topping.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Trim the rhubarb and cut into 2 cm pieces. Separate the eggs.
Cream butter, 125 g sugar, vanilla sugar and egg yolks. Stir in flour, baking powder, salt and milk. Spread into a springform pan.
Scatter the rhubarb on top and pre-bake.
steps.label: Pre-bake cake

steps.text: Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks, gradually add the remaining sugar until glossy. Spread over the cake and bake further.
steps.tip: The sugar must dissolve completely. Nothing should feel gritty between your fingers.
steps.label: Bake meringue

title: Strawberry and Asparagus Salad with Feta
summary: Green asparagus, sweet strawberries, rocket and feta with balsamic. Light, fresh and quick.

steps.text: Cut the asparagus into pieces and fry in 1 tbsp oil until tender-crisp.
steps.label: Fry asparagus

steps.text: Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan. Quarter the strawberries.
Whisk balsamic, honey, remaining oil, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: A pinch of pepper right on the strawberries brings out their sweetness.

steps.text: Combine rocket, asparagus and strawberries, crumble feta on top, serve with dressing and pine nuts.

title: Spring Minestrone
summary: Light vegetable soup with peas, asparagus, zucchini and small pasta, finished with a dollop of pesto.

steps.text: Dice onion and carrots and sweat in oil for 5 minutes.
Pour in the stock, bring to a boil. Add the pasta.
Cut zucchini and asparagus into pieces and add to the soup with the peas, simmer.
steps.tip: Add the green vegetables late so they stay crisp and bright.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Season and serve with pesto and Parmesan.

title: Herb Deviled Eggs
summary: The Easter classic: eggs with a creamy mustard and herb filling, sprinkled with paprika and cress.

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs, rinse in cold water and peel.
steps.tip: Eggs that are a few days old peel far more easily than very fresh ones.
steps.label: Boil eggs

steps.text: Halve lengthwise and remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with mayonnaise, cream cheese, mustard and chives until smooth, season.
Pipe or spoon into the egg whites, garnish with paprika and cress.

title: Sweet Easter Bread
summary: Soft yeast bread with raisins, almonds and lemon zest, scored with a cross.

steps.text: Warm the milk, melt the butter in it. Knead with flour, yeast, sugar, 1 egg, salt and lemon zest for 8 minutes.
Knead in raisins and almonds. Cover and let rise until doubled.
steps.tip: Soak the raisins in warm water for 10 minutes first so they don't burn.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Shape into a round loaf, place on a tray and let rise again.
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Brush the loaf with beaten egg, score a cross and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake Easter bread

title: Herb-Crusted Salmon
summary: Juicy oven-baked salmon under a crispy crust of herbs, breadcrumbs and lemon. Lovely for Easter.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Finely chop the herbs and knead with breadcrumbs, soft butter and lemon zest.
Salt the salmon, brush thinly with mustard and press the herb mixture on top.
steps.tip: The mustard works like glue. The crust stays put and the fish stays juicy.

steps.text: Bake until the salmon is just translucent in the center. Serve with lemon wedges and potatoes.
steps.label: Bake salmon

title: Pasta Primavera
summary: Colorful spring pasta with asparagus, peas, zucchini and snow peas in a light lemon butter.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Cook the pasta. Add asparagus, snow peas and peas to the water 4 minutes before the end.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Fry the zucchini in butter for 3 minutes. Add pasta and vegetables with some pasta water, toss with Parmesan and lemon zest.
steps.tip: Pasta water, butter and Parmesan emulsify into a silky sauce as you toss. No cream needed.

steps.text: Serve with basil, salt and pepper.

title: Kohlrabi Carpaccio with Goat Cheese
summary: Paper-thin kohlrabi slices with lemon, walnuts, goat cheese and honey. Served with fresh bread.

steps.text: Peel the kohlrabi and slice paper-thin with a mandoline. Spread out on plates.
Sprinkle with salt and let sit for 5 minutes.
steps.tip: The salt softens the slices and draws out a little water, so they taste more intense.

steps.text: Whisk lemon juice, oil and honey and drizzle over.
Top with goat cheese, roughly chopped walnuts and chives, add pepper. Serve with bread.

title: Zucchini Lasagna with Ricotta
summary: Summery lasagna with zucchini slices, tomato sauce, ricotta and mozzarella.

steps.text: Slice the zucchini lengthwise thinly, salt and let sit for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
steps.tip: This way the zucchini loses water beforehand and the lasagna won't turn watery.
steps.label: Let zucchini sweat

steps.text: Sweat the garlic in oil, add the passata, simmer for 10 minutes, season with basil, salt and pepper.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Layer sauce, sheets, zucchini and ricotta. Finish with sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake until golden and rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
steps.label: Bake lasagna

title: Grilled Halloumi with Watermelon
summary: Salty grilled halloumi meets juicy watermelon, mint, cucumber and lime.

steps.text: Cube the melon and cucumber, mix with lime juice, mint and 1 tbsp oil.
Slice the halloumi and fry in a hot grill pan until golden on both sides.
steps.tip: Serve halloumi hot. It turns rubbery once it cools.
steps.label: Grill halloumi

steps.text: Lay the halloumi on the salad, sprinkle with chili flakes, serve with warm pita.

title: Cold Soba with Sesame Dressing
summary: Refreshing buckwheat noodles with cucumber, edamame and a nutty sesame-soy dressing.

steps.text: Cook the soba as directed, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes.
steps.label: Cook soba

steps.text: Drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water.
steps.tip: Rinse until the water runs clear. It removes the starch so the noodles don't stick.

steps.text: Whisk tahini, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, honey and 2 tbsp water.
Cut the cucumber into sticks, the spring onions into rings. Toss everything with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame.

title: Baked Giant Beans
summary: Greek giant beans baked in tomato sauce with dill and feta.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Dice onion, garlic and carrot and soften in 3 tbsp oil.
Add the tomatoes and oregano, simmer for 5 minutes. Fold in the beans and half the dill, season.
Transfer to a baking dish, drizzle with the remaining oil and bake.
steps.tip: Be generous with the olive oil. It makes the beans creamy and slightly crisp at the edges.
steps.label: Bake beans

steps.text: Top with feta and the remaining dill, serve with flatbread.

title: Corn Fritters with Avocado Dip
summary: Crispy fritters packed with sweet corn, served with a fresh avocado-lime dip.

steps.text: Drain the corn well. Mix with eggs, flour, spring onions, smoked paprika, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil, drop in small mounds, flatten and fry until golden on both sides.
steps.tip: Pat the corn dry first. Only then do the fritters get truly crisp.
steps.label: Fry fritters

steps.text: Mash the avocado with sour cream, lime juice and salt and serve alongside.

title: Eggplant Rolls with Ricotta
summary: Grilled eggplant slices rolled around ricotta and basil, baked in tomato sauce.

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthwise 5 mm thick, brush with oil and cook in a grill pan until soft.
steps.tip: The slices need to be fully soft, or they'll crack when rolled.
steps.label: Grill eggplant

steps.text: Simmer the passata briefly with garlic, salt and some basil, pour into a baking dish. Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F).
Mix ricotta with Parmesan, chopped basil and pepper, spread on the slices and roll up.
Set the rolls in the sauce, top with mozzarella and bake.
steps.label: Bake rolls

title: Grilled Peach with Burrata
summary: Caramelized peaches, creamy burrata, basil and crusty bread. A summer evening on a plate.

steps.text: Halve and pit the peaches, brush the cut sides with oil.
Sear cut side down in a very hot grill pan until charred stripes appear.
steps.tip: Don't move them while they sear. That's how you get proper char marks.
steps.label: Grill peaches

steps.text: Spread rocket on plates, add the peaches and torn burrata.
Finish with balsamic, oil, flaky salt, pepper and basil. Toast the bread and serve alongside.

title: Cherry Bread Pudding
summary: Stale rolls, milk, eggs and plenty of cherries, baked until golden. Leftovers at their finest.

steps.text: Slice the rolls thinly. Warm the milk and pour over, soak for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Drain the cherries.
Beat soft butter with sugar, vanilla sugar and egg yolks until fluffy, add almonds and cinnamon, mix with the bread. Fold in the cherries.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold in gently. Pour into a greased dish and bake.
steps.tip: The whipped whites make it airy instead of dense.
steps.label: Bake pudding

title: Redcurrant Meringue Cake
summary: Shortcrust base, tart redcurrants and a tall, delicate meringue top.

steps.text: Knead flour, cold butter, 60 g sugar, 1 egg, baking powder and salt. Press into a springform pan with a rim, chill.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Sprinkle the base with almonds and pre-bake.
steps.tip: The almonds soak up the berry juice so the base stays crisp.
steps.label: Pre-bake base

steps.text: Whip 3 egg whites stiff, gradually add the remaining sugar and cornstarch. Mix half with the stripped berries and spread on the base.
Pile the remaining meringue on top and bake until the peaks are golden.
steps.label: Bake cake

title: Couscous with Grilled Vegetables and Yogurt
summary: Warm couscous with tray-roasted peppers, zucchini and eggplant, herbs and garlic yogurt.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Dice the vegetables, toss with 3 tbsp oil, cumin and salt and roast.
steps.label: Roast vegetables

steps.text: Pour hot stock over the couscous, cover and let swell for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Stir the yogurt with grated garlic and salt.
Mix the couscous with the vegetables, herbs, lemon juice and remaining oil, serve with the yogurt.
steps.tip: Lots of lemon and plenty of herbs turn plain couscous into something fresh.

title: Orzo Salad with Tomatoes and Feta
summary: Orzo with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta and a lemon-oregano dressing. Ideal for barbecues.

steps.text: Cook the orzo in salted water until al dente, drain and rinse briefly in cold water.
steps.label: Cook orzo

steps.text: Halve the tomatoes, dice the cucumber, thinly slice the onion.
Whisk lemon juice, oil, oregano, salt and pepper and toss with the orzo and vegetables.
steps.tip: Dress the orzo while still slightly warm. It absorbs the dressing much better.

steps.text: Fold in the olives and crumbled feta.

title: Ajo Blanco
summary: Cold Spanish almond soup with garlic and white bread, served with green grapes.

steps.text: Remove the crusts from the bread, soak in cold water, then squeeze out.
Blend almonds, bread, garlic, vinegar, salt and 500 ml ice-cold water very finely. Slowly stream in the oil.
steps.tip: Halve the garlic and remove the green germ first. The soup then tastes mild rather than harsh.

steps.text: Chill for at least 1 hour.
steps.label: Chill soup

steps.text: Ladle into bowls, serve with halved grapes and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Corn on the Cob with Lime-Chili Butter
summary: Grilled corn on the cob with spicy lime butter and feta, plus a crisp tomato salad.

steps.text: Mash the butter with lime zest, chili flakes and salt.
Grill the corn in a grill pan or on the barbecue, turning, until charred all over.
steps.tip: Spread the butter onto the hot cobs. It melts into every groove.
steps.label: Grill corn

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes and onion, toss with oil, lime juice and salt.
Brush the corn with the butter, sprinkle with feta and cilantro, serve with the salad.

title: Chicken Skewers with Tzatziki
summary: Lemon-marinated chicken skewers, homemade tzatziki and tomato salad. Pure summer.

steps.text: Cube the chicken, marinate with lemon juice, 2 tbsp oil, 2 garlic cloves, oregano and salt.
steps.tip: Don't marinate longer than a few hours. Too much lemon makes the meat mealy.
steps.label: Marinate

steps.text: Coarsely grate the cucumber, salt it and squeeze firmly. Stir into the yogurt with the remaining garlic and a little oil.
Thread the meat onto skewers and cook in a grill pan, turning.
steps.label: Grill skewers

steps.text: Serve with tzatziki, tomato wedges and warm flatbread.

title: Fish Parcels with Tomatoes and Olives
summary: White fish baked in paper with cherry tomatoes, olives, capers and lemon. Juicy, with no washing up.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Lay out two large sheets of baking paper.
Salt the fish and place on the paper. Scatter halved tomatoes, olives, capers, garlic and lemon slices around it, drizzle with oil.
Fold the paper over the fish and crimp the edges tightly.
steps.tip: Seal tightly. The trapped steam cooks the fish gently so it stays juicy.

steps.text: Bake and open at the table. Serve with basil and bread.
steps.label: Bake parcels

title: Pumpkin and Bean Chili
summary: Hearty vegetarian chili with Hokkaido pumpkin, black beans and cocoa. Perfect for Halloween night.

steps.text: Dice onion, garlic and pepper and fry in oil. Toast the cumin and paprika briefly.
Cut the pumpkin, skin on, into 2 cm cubes, add with the tomatoes, beans and 200 ml water.
Simmer covered until the pumpkin is soft. Stir in the cocoa and season.
steps.tip: You won't taste a teaspoon of cocoa, but it makes the chili deeper and rounder.
steps.label: Simmer chili

steps.text: Serve with sour cream.

title: Pumpkin Cinnamon Muffins
summary: Moist muffins with grated pumpkin, cinnamon and a cream cheese topping. Ideal for Halloween.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F), line a muffin tin. Finely grate the pumpkin.
Whisk eggs, sugar and oil. Stir in flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt, then the pumpkin.
steps.tip: Stir only until no flour is visible. That keeps the muffins tender.

steps.text: Divide into the cases and bake.
steps.label: Bake muffins

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese with powdered sugar and spread onto the cooled muffins.

title: Green Witch's Soup
summary: Bright green broccoli and spinach soup with croutons. Kids love the name, adults love the taste.

steps.text: Dice the onion and sweat in butter. Dice the potatoes, cut the broccoli into florets, add both with the stock.
Simmer until everything is soft.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Add the spinach and cream and blend smooth right away. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Add the spinach right at the end. The soup stays vivid green instead of olive gray.

steps.text: Cube the bread, toast in a pan until crisp and scatter over the soup.

title: Pumpkin Mac and Cheese
summary: Creamy macaroni in an orange cheese sauce made from pumpkin and cheddar, baked until crisp.

steps.text: Dice the pumpkin, cook in a little salted water until soft, then purée.
steps.label: Cook pumpkin

steps.text: Cook the macaroni 2 minutes less than the package says. Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F).
steps.label: Cook macaroni

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until smooth. Stir in the pumpkin purée, mustard, nutmeg and two thirds of the cheese.
steps.tip: The pumpkin makes the sauce creamier while using less cheese.

steps.text: Mix in the pasta, transfer to a dish, top with the remaining cheese and breadcrumbs and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake

title: Crispy Baked Spring Rolls
summary: Spring rolls filled with cabbage, carrots and glass noodles, baked crisp in the oven instead of fried.

steps.text: Soak the glass noodles and cut shorter. Cut cabbage, carrots and mushrooms into fine strips.
Stir-fry the vegetables with ginger briefly, season with soy sauce and sesame oil, mix in the noodles and let cool.
steps.tip: The filling must be completely cold. Warm filling softens the wrappers.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 210 °C (410 °F). Spoon filling onto the wrappers, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Brush with oil.
Bake on a tray until golden, turning halfway. Serve with chili sauce.
steps.label: Bake rolls

title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
summary: Spiced scramble made from crumbled tofu with turmeric, spinach and tomatoes. High in protein and ready in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Crumble the tofu roughly with your hands.
Fry the spring onions in oil, add the tofu and turmeric and fry until lightly browned.
steps.tip: Don't stir the tofu constantly. Leaving it a moment gives the browned bits that taste eggy.
steps.label: Fry tofu

steps.text: Fold in the halved tomatoes and spinach until it wilts. Season with nutritional yeast, salt and pepper.
Serve with toasted bread.

title: Sheet-Pan Gnocchi with Vegetables
summary: Crispy roasted gnocchi with peppers, zucchini, red onions and mozzarella. All on one tray.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Cut the vegetables into pieces.
Toss the uncooked gnocchi with the vegetables, tomatoes, oil, salt and pepper on a tray and roast, turning once.
steps.tip: Don't boil the gnocchi. Straight from the pack they turn crisp outside and soft inside.
steps.label: Roast tray

steps.text: Scatter the mozzarella over and bake 5 more minutes. Drizzle with pesto.
steps.label: Finish baking

title: Red Lentil Coconut Soup
summary: Velvety soup of red lentils, coconut milk, ginger and lime. Warms you from the inside.

steps.text: Dice onion, garlic, ginger and carrots and sweat in oil. Toast the curry powder briefly.
Add lentils, stock and coconut milk and simmer until the lentils break down.
steps.label: Simmer soup

steps.text: Blend smooth, season with lime juice and salt, serve with cilantro.
steps.tip: Add the lime at the end. Acid lifts all the flavors, but only when it goes in fresh.

title: Crispy Chickpea Bowl
summary: Roasted chickpeas, quinoa, cucumber, red cabbage and a creamy tahini-lemon dressing.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Rinse the chickpeas, pat very dry, roast with oil, smoked paprika and salt.
steps.tip: The drier the chickpeas, the crispier they get.
steps.label: Roast chickpeas

steps.text: Cook the quinoa in twice its volume of water.
steps.label: Cook quinoa

steps.text: Shred the red cabbage finely and massage with a little lemon juice and salt. Slice the cucumber and avocado.
Whisk the tahini with the remaining lemon juice, salt and water until creamy. Arrange everything in bowls.

title: Crispy Mushroom Tacos
summary: King oyster mushrooms seared with smoky spices, red cabbage slaw and lime sour cream.

steps.text: Tear or slice the mushrooms lengthwise into strips.
Sear in a very hot pan with oil without stirring, then turn and season with paprika, cumin and salt.
steps.tip: Salt the mushrooms at the end. Salt draws out water and they'd stew instead of sear.
steps.label: Sear mushrooms

steps.text: Shred the cabbage, toss with lime juice and salt. Stir the sour cream with lime zest.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, fill and sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Sweet Potato Peanut Curry
summary: Creamy curry with sweet potatoes, spinach, coconut milk and peanut butter. Mild, filling, easy.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Sweat onion and ginger in oil, toast the curry paste for 1 minute.
Dice the sweet potatoes, add with the coconut milk, peanut butter and 200 ml water and simmer until tender.
steps.tip: The peanut butter thickens the sauce and makes it wonderfully nutty.
steps.label: Simmer curry

steps.text: Fold in the spinach, season with lime juice and salt. Serve with rice and chopped peanuts.

title: Tortellini in Creamy Spinach Sauce
summary: Filled pasta in a quick sauce of spinach, cream, garlic and Parmesan. Ready in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Cook the tortellini as directed.
steps.label: Cook tortellini

steps.text: Sweat the garlic in butter, add the cream and reduce for 3 minutes. Add the spinach until it wilts.
Fold in the tortellini, Parmesan, a little lemon zest and nutmeg, season.
steps.tip: A little lemon zest takes the heaviness out of a cream sauce.

title: Pasta with Broccoli and Gorgonzola
summary: Bold Gorgonzola sauce with broccoli and toasted walnuts. A winter dish in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Cut the broccoli into small florets. Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 4 minutes.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan and chop.
Heat the cream with the garlic, melt the Gorgonzola in it. Toss in the pasta and broccoli with a little pasta water.
steps.tip: Don't let the sauce boil or the cheese turns grainy.

steps.text: Serve with walnuts and plenty of pepper.

title: Savory Spinach Pancakes
summary: Green pancakes filled with cream cheese, tomatoes and rocket. Quick, colorful, kid-friendly.

steps.text: Blend flour, milk, eggs, spinach and salt until smooth. Rest for 10 minutes.
steps.tip: Resting lets the flour hydrate so the pancakes don't tear.
steps.label: Rest batter

steps.text: Cook thin pancakes in a little butter.
steps.label: Cook pancakes

steps.text: Spread with cream cheese, top with tomato slices and rocket, add pepper and roll up.

title: Polenta Fries with Herb Dip
summary: Oven-baked polenta fries, crisp outside and creamy inside, with Parmesan and a yogurt herb dip.

steps.text: Bring the stock to a boil, whisk in the polenta and cook, stirring, until thick. Stir in butter and Parmesan.
steps.label: Cook polenta

steps.text: Spread 2 cm thick on a lined tray and let set.
steps.tip: The polenta must be fully firm or the fries break when you cut them.
steps.label: Let polenta set

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 230 °C (445 °F). Cut into sticks, brush with oil and rosemary and bake until crisp, turning once.
steps.label: Bake fries

steps.text: Stir the yogurt with chives, garlic and salt and serve alongside.

title: Black Bean Burger
summary: Juicy patties of black beans, oats and spices with avocado and smoky mayo.

steps.text: Rinse the beans, drain well and dry in the oven at 180 °C (355 °F) for 10 minutes.
steps.tip: Drying them first is the trick that keeps the patties from going mushy.
steps.label: Dry beans

steps.text: Roughly mash the beans, mix with finely chopped onion, oats, egg, spices and salt. Shape 4 patties.
Fry in oil until crisp on each side.
steps.label: Fry patties

steps.text: Toast the buns and layer with mayo, avocado, patty and tomato.

title: Sesame Tofu with Broccoli
summary: Crispy tofu cubes and broccoli in a glossy soy, honey and sesame sauce over rice.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cube and toss in cornstarch. Fry in oil until crisp all over, remove.
steps.tip: The starch forms a thin crust that the sauce clings to later.
steps.label: Fry tofu

steps.text: Stir-fry the broccoli with garlic and ginger for 4 minutes, add a splash of water and steam covered for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, honey and sesame oil, toss in the tofu until glossy. Serve on rice with sesame seeds.

title: Udon with Mushrooms and Bok Choy
summary: Thick udon noodles with shiitake, bok choy and a savory soy butter sauce. Quick and comforting.

steps.text: Loosen the udon in hot water as directed and drain.
Slice the mushrooms and fry hard in oil. Add garlic and halved bok choy, fry for 2 minutes.
steps.label: Fry mushrooms

steps.text: Add the noodles, soy sauce, mirin and butter and toss until glossy. Sprinkle with spring onions.
steps.tip: Butter and soy sauce are an unbeatable pair. The butter rounds out the saltiness.

title: Kimchi Pancake
summary: Crispy Korean pancake with kimchi and spring onions, served with a soy dipping sauce.

steps.text: Roughly chop the kimchi and mix with some of its juice, flour, cornstarch, spring onions and 150 ml ice-cold water into a thick batter.
steps.tip: Ice-cold water and cornstarch make the pancake extra crisp.

steps.text: Heat plenty of oil, spread the batter thinly and fry until crisp on both sides.
steps.label: Fry pancake

steps.text: Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame. Cut the pancake into pieces and serve with the dip.

title: Beet Risotto with Goat Cheese
summary: Pink risotto with beets, thyme and goat cheese. A real showstopper in winter.

steps.text: Purée half the beets, dice the rest. Keep the stock hot.
Sweat the onion in butter until translucent, toast the rice and thyme for 1 minute, deglaze with the wine.
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring. After 10 minutes stir in the purée and cubes.
steps.tip: The purée turns the risotto evenly pink, the cubes add bite.
steps.label: Stir risotto

steps.text: Stir in the Parmesan and season. Serve topped with goat cheese and toasted walnuts.

title: Leek and Potato Gratin
summary: Thin potato slices and sweet leeks in cream, baked golden with mountain cheese.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Slice the leeks into rings and soften in butter.
Peel the potatoes and slice thinly. Heat cream, milk, garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Don't rinse the potato slices. Their starch binds the cream into a creamy sauce.

steps.text: Layer potatoes and leeks in a dish, pour the cream over, sprinkle with cheese.
Bake until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden.
steps.label: Bake gratin

title: Pasta with Savoy Cabbage and Lemon Crumbs
summary: Gently braised savoy cabbage with garlic, butter and Parmesan, topped with crispy lemon breadcrumbs.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Toast the breadcrumbs in oil until golden, mix in lemon zest and a pinch of salt.
Cook the spaghetti. Cut the cabbage into thin strips and braise covered in butter with garlic and chili until soft.
steps.tip: Savoy cabbage turns sweet and almost nutty when braised slowly in butter.
steps.label: Braise cabbage

steps.text: Add the spaghetti with some pasta water and Parmesan to the cabbage and toss well. Serve with the lemon crumbs.

title: Swede Stew
summary: Northern German winter stew with swede, potatoes, carrots and marjoram. Here vegetarian with smoked tofu.

steps.text: Peel and dice the swede, potatoes and carrots. Dice the onion.
Dice the smoked tofu and fry in oil until crisp, remove. Sweat the onion in the same pot.
Add the vegetables and stock and simmer until everything is soft.
steps.tip: Roughly mash some of the vegetables in the pot. It makes the stew thick and hearty.
steps.label: Simmer stew

steps.text: Season with marjoram, salt and pepper, scatter over the tofu and parsley.

title: Pasta with Brussels Sprouts and Mountain Cheese
summary: Halved Brussels sprouts seared golden, tossed with pasta, mountain cheese, hazelnuts and lemon.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it generously.
Trim and halve the sprouts. Cook the pasta.
steps.label: Cook pasta

steps.text: Sear the sprouts cut side down in oil until deep golden. Add garlic and butter.
steps.tip: Patience pays off. The dark sear makes sprouts sweet instead of bitter.
steps.label: Sear sprouts

steps.text: Toss in the pasta with some pasta water, grated cheese and lemon juice. Serve with chopped hazelnuts.

title: Chestnut and Mushroom Pan with Dumplings
summary: Seared mushrooms and chestnuts in cream with thyme, served with sliced bread dumplings. Autumn on a plate.

steps.text: Slice the dumpling loaf and fry in 15 g butter until golden on both sides. Keep warm.
steps.label: Fry dumplings

steps.text: Quarter the mushrooms and sear hard in the remaining butter. Add shallots and halved chestnuts.
steps.tip: Fry mushrooms in batches, or the pan gets crowded and they turn watery.
steps.label: Sear mushrooms

steps.text: Add cream and thyme, reduce briefly, season. Serve with the dumplings and parsley.

title: Garlic Mushrooms on Toast
summary: Juicy mushrooms in garlic butter with parsley and lemon on crispy sourdough. A quick supper.

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms and sear in hot oil without stirring until browned.
steps.label: Sear mushrooms

steps.text: Add butter and chopped garlic, toss for 1 minute. Stir in crème fraîche, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
steps.tip: Add garlic at the end. In a hot pan it burns quickly and turns bitter.

steps.text: Toast the bread, pile on the mushrooms, sprinkle with parsley.

title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
summary: Silky chicken soup with rice, thickened with egg and lemon. Comforting and fresh at once.

steps.text: Gently poach the chicken and halved onion in the stock. Remove the meat and shred it, discard the onion.
steps.label: Poach chicken

steps.text: Add the rice to the stock and cook until soft.
steps.label: Cook rice

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice. Gradually whisk in a ladle of hot stock, then pour everything back into the pot.
steps.tip: The soup must not boil afterwards or the egg will curdle.

steps.text: Return the chicken, season with salt, pepper and dill.

title: Gnocchi with Chicken and Pesto
summary: Pan-fried gnocchi, tender chicken, cherry tomatoes and pesto from one pan. Ready in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Cut the chicken into strips, salt and fry in 1 tbsp oil until golden. Remove.
steps.label: Fry chicken

steps.text: Fry the gnocchi in the remaining oil until crisp.
steps.tip: Gnocchi go straight from the pack into the pan. Unboiled they get much crispier.
steps.label: Fry gnocchi

steps.text: Add tomatoes and spinach until the tomatoes burst. Toss in the chicken and pesto, serve with Parmesan.

title: Pork Medallions with Peppercorn Cream
summary: Tender pork tenderloin medallions in green peppercorn sauce with ribbon noodles. Festive and quick.

steps.text: Cut the tenderloin into 3 cm medallions and press flat. Cook the noodles.
steps.label: Cook noodles

steps.text: Salt the medallions and fry in clarified butter for 3 minutes per side. Rest in foil.
steps.tip: They can still be slightly pink inside. Resting finishes them perfectly.
steps.label: Fry medallions

steps.text: Sweat the shallot in the pan fat, deglaze with brandy, add cream and peppercorns and reduce until creamy.
Pour the resting juices into the sauce, turn the medallions in it briefly. Serve with the noodles.

title: Taco Rice Skillet
summary: Ground beef, rice, beans, corn and tomatoes with taco spices from one pan, topped with melted cheese.

steps.text: Dice the onion and brown with the beef in oil until crumbly. Add cumin and paprika.
Add the rice, tomatoes, drained beans and corn and 400 ml water, salt. Simmer covered until the rice is cooked.
steps.tip: Don't stir while the rice cooks. It won't stick and stays fluffy.
steps.label: Cook rice

steps.text: Sprinkle with cheese, cover briefly until melted. Serve with sour cream.

title: Fish Cakes with Remoulade
summary: Juicy pollock and potato fish cakes with dill, served with a quick remoulade and cucumber salad.

steps.text: Boil and mash the potatoes. Thaw the fish, pat dry and chop finely.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Combine fish, potatoes, egg, breadcrumbs, half the dill, lemon zest, salt and pepper. Shape into cakes.
steps.tip: Chill the mixture for 10 minutes. The cakes are easier to shape and won't fall apart.

steps.text: Fry in oil until golden on each side.
steps.label: Fry fish cakes

steps.text: Mix mayo with chopped pickles, lemon juice and dill. Slice the cucumber and salt it. Serve together.

title: Beef and Broccoli
summary: Tender beef strips and crisp broccoli in a glossy oyster sauce. Better than takeout.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, bring to a boil with 300 ml water and let it steam covered on the lowest heat.
steps.label: Rice

steps.text: Slice the beef thinly against the grain, mix with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
steps.tip: Slice against the grain and coat in starch. It keeps the meat tender and juicy.

steps.text: Sear the beef in batches in very hot oil, remove.
steps.label: Sear beef

steps.text: Stir-fry the broccoli with garlic and ginger, add 3 tbsp water and steam covered for 2 minutes. Add the beef, oyster sauce and remaining soy sauce and toss briefly. Serve with rice.

title: Spinach and Feta Puff Pastry Pinwheels
summary: Crispy party pinwheels with spinach, feta and sun-dried tomatoes. Perfect for a New Year's Eve buffet.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (390 °F). Finely chop the spinach and sun-dried tomatoes.
Unroll the pastry, spread with cream cheese, scatter spinach, tomatoes and crumbled feta, add pepper.
Roll up tightly from the long side and chill for 15 minutes. Cut into 1.5 cm slices.
steps.tip: Chilled, the roll slices cleanly without the filling squeezing out.
steps.label: Chill roll

steps.text: Lay on a tray, brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame and bake until golden.
steps.label: Bake pinwheels

title: New Year's Jam Doughnuts
summary: Fluffy fried yeast doughnuts filled with jam and rolled in sugar. A must on New Year's Eve.

steps.text: Warm the milk and melt the butter in it. Knead with flour, yeast, sugar, eggs and salt for 10 minutes into a soft dough.
Cover and let rise until doubled.
steps.label: Let dough rise

steps.text: Shape 16 balls, set on a floured cloth and let rise again.
steps.label: Second rise

steps.text: Heat the oil to 170 °C (340 °F). Lower the doughnuts in top side down, fry covered for 3 minutes, flip and finish uncovered.
steps.tip: Lid on first: the steam makes them puff up and creates the classic pale ring.
steps.label: Fry doughnuts

steps.text: Drain, pipe in the jam with a nozzle and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Mulled Wine Pears with Vanilla Ice Cream
summary: Pears gently poached in spiced red wine with cinnamon and cloves. A festive dessert you can make ahead.

steps.text: Bring the wine to a boil with the sugar, spices and orange peel.
Peel the pears, leaving the stems on, and stand them in the liquid. Poach gently covered until tender, turning now and then.
steps.tip: Left in the liquid overnight, the pears turn deep red and even more aromatic.
steps.label: Poach pears

steps.text: Remove the pears and reduce the liquid to a syrup.
steps.label: Reduce syrup

steps.text: Serve the pears with the syrup and vanilla ice cream.

title: Soft Nut Gingerbread
summary: Soft gingerbread with lots of nuts and little flour on wafers, with chocolate or sugar glaze.

steps.text: Beat the eggs with sugar for 5 minutes until thick and pale.
Fold in the nuts, finely chopped candied peel, spice and baking powder.
steps.tip: Let the mixture rest in the fridge overnight. The spices develop their full aroma.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160 °C (320 °F). Spread the mixture in domes onto the wafers.
Bake until dry outside but still soft inside.
steps.label: Bake gingerbread

steps.text: Let cool and coat with melted chocolate.

title: Homemade Chocolate Pudding
summary: Creamy pudding from milk, real chocolate and cocoa, no packet mix. Cooked in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Whisk the cornstarch, cocoa, sugar and salt with 100 ml milk until smooth.
Bring the remaining milk to a boil, melt the chocolate in it. Stir in the starch mixture and simmer for 1 minute, stirring.
steps.tip: The pinch of salt makes the chocolate taste much more intense.

steps.text: Pour into bowls, press cling film directly onto the surface and chill.
steps.label: Chill pudding

steps.text: Serve with whipped cream.

title: Quark Cream with Berries
summary: Airy lemon quark cream with fresh berries and crunchy oats. Light and summery.

steps.text: Toast the oats in butter with 1 tbsp honey until golden, let cool.
Stir the quark with the remaining honey, vanilla sugar, lemon zest and juice until smooth.
Whip the cream and fold in.
steps.tip: The whipped cream makes the quark as airy as a mousse.

steps.text: Layer with the berries in glasses and sprinkle with the oats.

title: Lemon Tart
summary: Shortcrust filled with a silky, fresh lemon cream. Tangy, sweet and wonderfully elegant.

steps.text: Quickly knead flour, 100 g cold butter, powdered sugar, 1 egg yolk, salt and 2 tbsp cold water. Press into a tart pan and chill.
steps.label: Chill dough

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (355 °F). Blind-bake the base with baking paper and dried beans.
steps.tip: Blind-baking prevents a soggy bottom under the wet filling.
steps.label: Blind-bake

steps.text: Whisk 3 eggs and the leftover egg white with sugar, lemon juice and zest, cream and the remaining melted butter.
Lower to 150 °C (300 °F), pour in the filling and bake until just set with a slight wobble in the center.
steps.label: Bake tart

steps.text: Let cool completely and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Herb Omelette with Goat Cheese
summary: Tender omelette with fresh herbs and melting goat cheese, with a small salad on the side.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with salt vigorously. Finely chop the herbs and mix in.
Let half the butter foam over medium heat, pour in half the eggs and stir with a fork until almost set.
steps.tip: Medium heat and off early. A good omelette is still creamy inside and barely browned.
steps.label: Cook omelette

steps.text: Crumble goat cheese over one half and fold over. Repeat with the second portion.
Dress the lettuce with oil, vinegar and salt and serve alongside.

title: Naan Pizza with Paneer and Spinach
summary: Ready-made naan as the base with spiced tomato sauce, paneer, spinach and mozzarella. Done in 15 minutes.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (430 °F). Stir the passata with garam masala and salt.
Spread the naan with sauce, top with spinach, cubed paneer, onion rings and torn mozzarella.
steps.tip: Spread the sauce thinly. Too much makes the naan soggy instead of crisp.

steps.text: Bake until the cheese bubbles. Sprinkle with cilantro.
steps.label: Bake pizza

title: Spelt Patties with Herb Quark
summary: Savory patties of green spelt, carrot and onion, crisp outside, with herb quark and salad.

steps.text: Bring the spelt to a boil in the stock and let swell over low heat for 15 minutes. Let cool.
steps.tip: Green spelt has a naturally smoky flavor. It needs hardly any seasoning.
steps.label: Soak spelt

steps.text: Finely grate the carrot, finely dice the onion. Knead with the spelt, egg, breadcrumbs, marjoram, salt and pepper. Shape 8 patties.
Fry in oil until golden on both sides.
steps.label: Fry patties

steps.text: Stir the quark with chives, salt and a little water until creamy and serve alongside.

title: Warm Fried Potato Salad with Fried Egg
summary: Crispy fried potatoes with lamb's lettuce, pickles and mustard dressing, crowned with a fried egg.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in their skins, let cool and slice.
steps.tip: Day-old potatoes are best. They get much crispier in the pan.
steps.label: Boil potatoes

steps.text: Fry in 2 tbsp oil without turning too often until golden, salt.
steps.label: Fry potatoes

steps.text: Whisk mustard, vinegar, remaining oil, salt and pepper. Thinly slice the onion and pickles.
Fry the eggs. Toss the potatoes with lamb's lettuce, onions, pickles and dressing, top with the eggs.
